raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Unlimited-OCR v1 (#29186) serves single images and short documents with a prefill-aware sliding window. [Unlimited-OCR-2](https://huggingface.co/baidu/Unlimited-OCR-2) (`UnlimitedOCRV2ForCausalLM`) targets long multi-page documents (hundreds of pages in one request). It replaces the sliding window with DASH sparse attention (a learned per-page router plus a per-page 2D position frame), so serving it needs a new attention backend, model, and processor, plus serving-side support for splitting a long document into page windows that reuse each other's KV cache.

## Modifications

**Model and attention**
- `models/unlimited_ocr_v2.py`, `multimodal/processors/unlimited_ocr_v2.py`; v2-only processor options in `configs/unlimited_ocr.py` (`v2_layout=True`; v1 keeps its upstream tile cap and crop layout).
- `layers/attention/unlimited_ocr_v2_backend.py`: DASH sparse attention (learned per-page entmax router, sparse prefill/decode attend, page-local 2D RoPE). Full prefill and decode CUDA graphs supported; eager decode also supported.
- Triton kernels in `kernels/ops/attention/unlimited_ocr_dash/` with `KernelSpec` registrations; runtime state (page/coord state, router math) stays in `srt/layers/attention/unlimited_dash_ops/`.
- `arg_groups/model_overrides/unlimited_ocr_v2.py`: selects the `unlimited_ocr_v2` backend, sets `page_size` to the sparse block size, disables the radix cache, and rejects unsupported modes (see below).
- `UnlimitedOCRV2KVPool` (K + router-index K) in `mem_cache/memory_pool.py`, sized in `kv_cache_configurator.py` / `pool_configurator.py`.

**SAM vision encoder (shared with DeepSeek-OCR / Unlimited-OCR v1)**
- Two JIT kernels, `elementwise.sam_rel_pos_bias` and `elementwise.window_unpartition_add`, used only when their contract holds (CUDA non-ROCm, bf16, shape/stride/alignment); otherwise the eager path runs. Query-chunked relative-position bias capped at 64 MiB.

**Long-document serving (v2 only)**

Serving, retained-window KV state, prefetch, scheduler hooks, and decode/crop helpers are owned by Unlimited-OCR v2 under `models/unlimited_ocr_v2_support/`. The serving loop owns window progress and a single prefetched successor; plans are validated once in `document_split.py`. The retained KV-row holder is `RetainedWindow`.
- `models/unlimited_ocr_v2_support/chat.py` + `models/unlimited_ocr_v2_support/document_split.py`: with `--uocr-doc-split`, a multi-page chat request is split into page windows (with lookahead pages) and answered as one response / one stream. Windowing with KV splicing is approximate and opt-in; the default serves the whole document. `serving_chat.py` only gets a `None`-checked hook. If a window is rejected for exceeding context while other windows succeed, the non-streaming response preserves their text and usage, reports an incomplete document with `finish_reason="length"`, and includes the rejected window in its diagnostic metadata. The cookbook client checks `doc_split_complete` before using the text as a complete document.
- `models/unlimited_ocr_v2_support/document_reuse.py` (`DocReuse`), `models/unlimited_ocr_v2_support/retained_window.py`: a finished window's KV tail is retained and copied into the next window instead of re-encoding and re-prefilling the overlap page.
- `models/unlimited_ocr_v2_support/document_prefetch.py` (`DocPrefetch`, `EarlyEmbeddings`): the next window is sent while the current one decodes and its pages are vision-encoded early on a side stream.
- Per-page output cap (`--uocr-max-page-tokens`) through the built-in page guard, without enabling external custom logit processors. External serialized processors still require `--enable-custom-logit-processor`. The processor collects its per-row bans / forced tokens and applies them with one non-blocking index upload, so it never blocks the host on the forward.
- With doc split, the request pool has `2 * max_running_requests` rows: each in-flight document may hold a retained window row next to its running row (the running cap is unchanged). Without this, retained windows were evicted near the running cap and the follow-up window lost its predecessor's context.

**Scheduler / runtime (created only for Unlimited-OCR v2; `None` otherwise)**
- `models/unlimited_ocr_v2_support/scheduler_hooks.py` owns all per-scheduler document state (no module globals) and is reset by `flush_cache`.
- `models/unlimited_ocr_v2_support/async_shm.py`, `models/unlimited_ocr_v2_support/overlap_release.py`, `models/unlimited_ocr_v2_support/crop_transfer.py`: SHM materialization off the scheduler thread, deferred overlap release, pinned crop prefetch.
- `models/unlimited_ocr_v2_support/greedy_graph.py`, `models/unlimited_ocr_v2_support/decode_graph_io.py`: greedy argmax recorded in the decode graph and decode inputs relayed through it.
- `Scheduler` / `ModelRunner` only construct, wire and delegate; request-side state is declared on `Req` (`uocr_doc`, `page_guard_state`).

**Unsupported with Unlimited-OCR v2 (rejected at launch with a clear error)**
- speculative decoding, `--pp-size > 1`, PD disaggregation;
- `--dp-size > 1` / DP attention while doc split is on (omit `--uocr-doc-split`).

**New server arguments**

| Flag | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--uocr-doc-split` | off | Opt into approximate page-window processing with KV reuse |
| `--uocr-doc-page-window` | 1 | Maximum transcribed pages per window, across all image modes |
| `--uocr-max-page-tokens` | 0 | Per-page output token cap (0 = off); enforced by the built-in page guard |

The model-owned `UocrDocumentConfig` declares and validates these CLI arguments. Advanced request settings use typed `doc_split_options`: `max_batch_pages` (may tighten the server window), `overlap_pages` (default 0), `lookahead_pages` (default 1), and `max_page_tokens` (may tighten the server cap). A larger lookahead can require an explicit `--context-length`. Window settings require `--uocr-doc-split`; per-page limits can also be used with whole-document serving.

**Internal environment overrides** (expert kill-switches / resource thresholds; not semantic model settings): `SGLANG_ENABLE_UOCR_DOC_PREFETCH`, `SGLANG_UOCR_DOC_PREFETCH_MAX_MB`, `SGLANG_ENABLE_UOCR_CROP_PREFETCH`, `SGLANG_UOCR_CROP_PREFETCH_MAX_MB`, `SGLANG_ENABLE_UOCR_ASYNC_SHM_MATERIALIZATION`, `SGLANG_UOCR_ASYNC_SHM_MAX_MB`, `SGLANG_ENABLE_UOCR_SHM_WRAP_MODEL_DATA`.

**Changes visible to other models**
- Custom logit processors: when every row of the batch uses the same processor, it is applied to the full logits in place (bit-exact; saves two full-logits copies per step).
- SAM encoder JIT kernels (above) for DeepSeek-OCR / OCR2 / Unlimited-OCR v1 on bf16 CUDA; a kernel bug for strided `rel_w` inputs is rejected instead of producing a wrong bias.
- `DeepseekOCRNoRepeatNGramLogitProcessor`: new opt-in params; with default params output is identical (3000 random cases). Out-of-vocab banned ids are ignored instead of raising.
- Fastokens: unchanged for every tokenizer that loaded before. A tokenizer whose `tokenizer.json` pre-tokenizer disagrees with its declared class (v2 declares `LlamaTokenizerFast` with a ByteLevel pre-tokenizer) used to fail under `--tokenizer-backend fastokens`; it now loads through Hugging Face with the v5 component fix and wraps the repaired backend.
- Unlimited-OCR v1 prompt building, processor and serving behave exactly as before.

**Tests and docs**
- Document planning and split-response tests: `test/registered/unit/models/unlimited_ocr_v2/test_document_split.py`.
- Unit tests under `test/registered/unit/{session,managers,mem_cache,sampling,entrypoints,server_args,models,layers/attention}`; kernel tests and benchmarks under `test/registered/kernels/{ops,benchmark}/{attention,elementwise}`; e2e server test `test/registered/vlm/test_unlimited_ocr_v2_server.py` (single page + multi-page with splitting and KV reuse).
- Cookbook page `Baidu/Unlimited-OCR-2.mdx` with its config; new flags in `server_arguments.mdx`.

## How to reproduce

Server (1x NVIDIA L20 48 GB). The command below uses the current CLI names. The benchmark results below are carried over from the original PR description at `f15f2d1aa007e7df0e79495285eb2f50f8389a90`, before the configuration cleanup. The original recipe used equivalent one-page windows; these results have not been remeasured on the current head. Only `--uocr-max-page-tokens` differs per benchmark:

```bash
SGLANG_VLM_CACHE_SIZE_MB=0 PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True \
python -m sglang.launch_server \
  --model-path baidu/Unlimited-OCR-2 \
  --served-model-name Unlimited-OCR-v2 \
  --host 0.0.0.0 --port 30000 \
  --tokenizer-worker-num 8 \
  --tokenizer-backend fastokens \
  --chat-template unlimited-ocr \
  --mem-fraction-static 0.7 \
  --max-running-requests 64 \
  --max-prefill-tokens 2048 \
  --random-seed 20260918 \
  --uocr-doc-split \
  --uocr-max-page-tokens 20000 \
  --enable-custom-logit-processor \
  --enable-streaming-session \
  --allow-auto-truncate \
  --disable-radix-cache \
  --mm-preprocess-cache-size-mb 0 \
  --cuda-graph-backend-decode full \
  --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 64 \
  --cuda-graph-backend-prefill full \
  --cuda-graph-max-bs-prefill 16384 \
  --cuda-graph-bs-prefill 1024 2048 \
  --cuda-graph-config '{"prefill": {"backend": "full", "full_prefill_max_req": 64}}'
```

`--uocr-max-page-tokens` is 8000 for MPDocBench and 20000 for MarathonDocBench. MPDocBench sends multi-page documents with `images_config.image_mode="base"` and single pages in the default `gundam` mode; MarathonDocBench uses `gundam`.

Request: one chat request per document, all pages in one message; the server splits it into page windows and returns one answer.

```python
from openai import OpenAI
from sglang.srt.sampling.custom_logit_processor import DeepseekOCRNoRepeatNGramLogitProcessor

client = OpenAI(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:30000/v1", api_key="EMPTY")
pages = [...]  # data URLs or http(s) URLs, in page order
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": u}} for u in pages]
content.append({"type": "text", "text": "<PAGE><image>" * len(pages) + "Multi page parsing."})
resp = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="Unlimited-OCR-v2",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": content}],
    temperature=0,
    max_tokens=20000 * len(pages),
    extra_body={
        "skip_special_tokens": False,
        "images_config": {"image_mode": "gundam"},
        "custom_logit_processor": DeepseekOCRNoRepeatNGramLogitProcessor.to_str(),
        "custom_params": {"ngram_size": 35, "window_size": 1024 if len(pages) > 1 else 128},
    },
)
```

## Accuracy Tests

sgl-eval has no OCR suite, so we report document-parsing benchmarks from the benchmark revision noted above; client temperature 0.

| Benchmark | Workload | Concurrency | Overall |
|---|---|---|---|
| MPDocBench | 420 multi-page documents | 32 | 84.74 |
| MarathonDocBench | 100 long documents | 32 | 77.16 |

Component scores:

| Component | MPDocBench | MarathonDocBench |
|---|---|---|
| TextEdit | 95.56 | 88.46 |
| T-TextEdit | 89.75 | 87.64 |
| ReadOrderEdit | 92.45 | 85.55 |
| FormulaCDM | 89.93 | 85.92 |
| TableTEDS | 86.82 | 75.82 |
| T-TableTEDS | 88.92 | 72.91 |
| FigureF1 | 74.28 | 71.83 |
| HeadingTEDS | 60.24 | 49.13 |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

MarathonDocBench throughput on 1x NVIDIA L20 48 GB, using the benchmark revision and configuration noted above (`--uocr-max-page-tokens 20000`): 64 long documents, 11,748 pages in total, every document sent as one request at a fixed client concurrency.

| Concurrency | Wall time (s) | Pages/s | Output tokens/s | Latency p50 / p90 (s) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 32 | 14879 | 0.7896 | 882.6 | 2283 / 4117 |
| 64 | 10813 | 1.0865 | 1113.8 | 3310 / 4760 |

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Notes for reviewers

### Reproducible module relocation

[Download the complete relocation proof](https://gist.github.com/mickqian/b6159a56250b5e47fe5f2389d4f89b7e) (script plus helper module). From an SGLang clone containing the PR commits, run the downloaded script:

```bash
python3 /path/to/downloaded-proof/a1de9d7a06c4.py
```

It reproduces the file moves and import rewrites from `946901681615` to `a1de9d7a06c4`, checks that non-import ASTs are unchanged, runs the formatter, and compares the resulting tree byte-for-byte. Commit `7b90805e9061` separately updates internal type names, patch/ownership paths, and docstrings. Commits `78afd6bb66d6` and `183b32aac5b8` subsequently add early-exit lifecycle coverage and remove redundant window-plan state and forwarding layers; those serving changes are outside the mechanical relocation proof. Commits `c052a008af28` and `0e4c058d16a0` separately cover and repair missing diagnostic fields for context-rejected windows, with completion checks in the cookbook; `6c46206469ea` clarifies the partial-response condition.


- Kernel tests and benchmarks were run on L20 (SM89); the PDL path (SM90+) is not exercised locally. The kernel decode benchmark uses a stand-in 16-head / 128-dim attention shape.
- `test/registered/vlm/test_unlimited_ocr_v2_server.py` pins `baidu/Unlimited-OCR-2` at revision `5632329a`.

External serialized processors still require `--enable-custom-logit-processor`. The processor collects its per-row bans / forced tokens and applies them with one non-blocking index upload, so it never blocks the host on the forward.
- With doc split, the request pool has `2 * max_running_requests` rows: each in-flight document may hold a retained window row next to its running row (the running cap is unchanged). Without this, retained windows were evicted near the running cap and the follow-up window lost its predecessor's context.

**Scheduler / runtime (created only for Unlimited-OCR v2; `None` otherwise)**
- `models/unlimited_ocr_v2_support/scheduler_hooks.py` owns all per-scheduler document state (no module globals) and is reset by `flush_cache`.
- `models/unlimited_ocr_v2_support/async_shm.py`, `models/unlimited_ocr_v2_support/overlap_release.py`, `models/unlimited_ocr_v2_support/crop_transfer.py`: SHM materialization off the scheduler thread, deferred overlap release, pinned crop prefetch.
- `models/unlimited_ocr_v2_support/greedy_graph.py`, `models/unlimited_ocr_v2_support/decode_graph_io.py`: greedy argmax recorded in the decode graph and decode inputs relayed through it.
- `Scheduler` / `ModelRunner` only construct, wire and delegate; request-side state is declared on `Req` (`uocr_doc`, `page_guard_state`).

**Unsupported with Unlimited-OCR v2 (rejected at launch with a clear error)**
- speculative decoding, `--pp-size > 1`, PD disaggregation;
- `--dp-size > 1` / DP attention while doc split is on (omit `--uocr-doc-split`).

**New server arguments**

| Flag | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--uocr-doc-split` | off | Opt into approximate page-window processing with KV reuse |
| `--uocr-doc-page-window` | 1 | Maximum transcribed pages per window, across all image modes |
| `--uocr-max-page-tokens` | 0 | Per-page output token cap (0 = off); enforced by the built-in page guard |

The model-owned `UocrDocumentConfig` declares and validates these CLI arguments. Advanced request settings use typed `doc_split_options`: `max_batch_pages` (may tighten the server window), `overlap_pages` (default 0), `lookahead_pages` (default 1), and `max_page_tokens` (may tighten the server cap). A larger lookahead can require an explicit `--context-length`. Window settings require `--uocr-doc-split`; per-page limits can also be used with whole-document serving.

**Internal environment overrides** (expert kill-switches / resource thresholds; not semantic model settings): `SGLANG_ENABLE_UOCR_DOC_PREFETCH`, `SGLANG_UOCR_DOC_PREFETCH_MAX_MB`, `SGLANG_ENABLE_UOCR_CROP_PREFETCH`, `SGLANG_UOCR_CROP_PREFETCH_MAX_MB`, `SGLANG_ENABLE_UOCR_ASYNC_SHM_MATERIALIZATION`, `SGLANG_UOCR_ASYNC_SHM_MAX_MB`, `SGLANG_ENABLE_UOCR_SHM_WRAP_MODEL_DATA`.

**Changes visible to other models**
- Custom logit processors: when every row of the batch uses the same processor, it is applied to the full logits in place (bit-exact; saves two full-logits copies per step).
- SAM encoder JIT kernels (above) for DeepSeek-OCR / OCR2 / Unlimited-OCR v1 on bf16 CUDA; a kernel bug for strided `rel_w` inputs is rejected instead of producing a wrong bias.
- `DeepseekOCRNoRepeatNGramLogitProcessor`: new opt-in params; with default params output is identical (3000 random cases). Out-of-vocab banned ids are ignored instead of raising.
- Fastokens: unchanged for every tokenizer that loaded before. A tokenizer whose `tokenizer.json` pre-tokenizer disagrees with its declared class (v2 declares `LlamaTokenizerFast` with a ByteLevel pre-tokenizer) used to fail under `--tokenizer-backend fastokens`; it now loads through Hugging Face with the v5 component fix and wraps the repaired backend.
- Unlimited-OCR v1 prompt building, processor and serving behave exactly as before.

**Tests and docs**
- Document planning and split-response tests: `test/registered/unit/models/unlimited_ocr_v2/test_document_split.py`.
- Unit tests under `test/registered/unit/{session,managers,mem_cache,sampling,entrypoints,server_args,models,layers/attention}`; kernel tests and benchmarks under `test/registered/kernels/{ops,benchmark}/{attention,elementwise}`; e2e server test `test/registered/vlm/test_unlimited_ocr_v2_server.py` (single page + multi-page with splitting and KV reuse).
- Cookbook page `Baidu/Unlimited-OCR-2.mdx` with its config; new flags in `server_arguments.mdx`.

## How to reproduce

Server (1x NVIDIA L20 48 GB). The command below uses the current CLI names. The benchmark results below are carried over from the original PR description at `f15f2d1aa007e7df0e79495285eb2f50f8389a90`, before the configuration cleanup. The original recipe used equivalent one-page windows; these results have not been remeasured on the current head. Only `--uocr-max-page-tokens` differs per benchmark:

```bash
SGLANG_VLM_CACHE_SIZE_MB=0 PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True \
python -m sglang.launch_server \
  --model-path baidu/Unlimited-OCR-2 \
  --served-model-name Unlimited-OCR-v2 \
  --host 0.0.0.0 --port 30000 \
  --tokenizer-worker-num 8 \
  --tokenizer-backend fastokens \
  --chat-template unlimited-ocr \
  --mem-fraction-static 0.7 \
  --max-running-requests 64 \
  --max-prefill-tokens 2048 \
  --random-seed 20260918 \
  --uocr-doc-split \
  --uocr-max-page-tokens 20000 \
  --enable-custom-logit-processor \
  --enable-streaming-session \
  --allow-auto-truncate \
  --disable-radix-cache \
  --mm-preprocess-cache-size-mb 0 \
  --cuda-graph-backend-decode full \
  --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 64 \
  --cuda-graph-backend-prefill full \
  --cuda-graph-max-bs-prefill 16384 \
  --cuda-graph-bs-prefill 1024 2048 \
  --cuda-graph-config '{"prefill": {"backend": "full", "full_prefill_max_req": 64}}'
```

`--uocr-max-page-tokens` is 8000 for MPDocBench and 20000 for MarathonDocBench. MPDocBench sends multi-page documents with `images_config.image_mode="base"` and single pages in the default `gundam` mode; MarathonDocBench uses `gundam`.

Request: one chat request per document, all pages in one message; the server splits it into page windows and returns one answer.

```python
from openai import OpenAI
from sglang.srt.sampling.custom_logit_processor import DeepseekOCRNoRepeatNGramLogitProcessor

client = OpenAI(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:30000/v1", api_key="EMPTY")
pages = [...]  # data URLs or http(s) URLs, in page order
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": u}} for u in pages]
content.append({"type": "text", "text": "<PAGE><image>" * len(pages) + "Multi page parsing."})
resp = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="Unlimited-OCR-v2",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": content}],
    temperature=0,
    max_tokens=20000 * len(pages),
    extra_body={
        "skip_special_tokens": False,
        "images_config": {"image_mode": "gundam"},
        "custom_logit_processor": DeepseekOCRNoRepeatNGramLogitProcessor.to_str(),
        "custom_params": {"ngram_size": 35, "window_size": 1024 if len(pages) > 1 else 128},
    },
)
```

## Accuracy Tests

sgl-eval has no OCR suite, so we report document-parsing benchmarks from the benchmark revision noted above; client temperature 0.

| Benchmark | Workload | Concurrency | Overall |
|---|---|---|---|
| MPDocBench | 420 multi-page documents | 32 | 84.74 |
| MarathonDocBench | 100 long documents | 32 | 77.16 |

| FigureF1 | 74.28 | 71.83 |
| HeadingTEDS | 60.24 | 49.13 |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

MarathonDocBench throughput on 1x NVIDIA L20 48 GB, using the benchmark revision and configuration noted above (`--uocr-max-page-tokens 20000`): 64 long documents, 11,748 pages in total, every document sent as one request at a fixed client concurrency.

| Concurrency | Wall time (s) | Pages/s | Output tokens/s | Latency p50 / p90 (s) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 32 | 14879 | 0.7896 | 882.6 | 2283 / 4117 |
| 64 | 10813 | 1.0865 | 1113.8 | 3310 / 4760 |

- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Notes for reviewers

### Reproducible module relocation

[Download the complete relocation proof](https://gist.github.com/mickqian/b6159a56250b5e47fe5f2389d4f89b7e) (script plus helper module). From an SGLang clone containing the PR commits, run the downloaded script:

```bash
python3 /path/to/downloaded-proof/a1de9d7a06c4.py
```

It reproduces the file moves and import rewrites from `946901681615` to `a1de9d7a06c4`, checks that non-import ASTs are unchanged, runs the formatter, and compares the resulting tree byte-for-byte. Commit `7b90805e9061` separately updates internal type names, patch/ownership paths, and docstrings. Commits `78afd6bb66d6` and `183b32aac5b8` subsequently add early-exit lifecycle coverage and remove redundant window-plan state and forwarding layers; those serving changes are outside the mechanical relocation proof. Commits `c052a008af28` and `0e4c058d16a0` separately cover and repair missing diagnostic fields for context-rejected windows, with completion checks in the cookbook; `6c46206469ea` clarifies the partial-response condition.


- Kernel tests and benchmarks were run on L20 (SM89); the PDL path (SM90+) is not exercised locally. The kernel decode benchmark uses a stand-in 16-head / 128-dim attention shape.

+"""Bias-aware block-sparse GQA attention for DASH (Triton).
+
+Adds a per-(query, slot) additive ``log(prior)/sigma`` bias to REMOTE blocks only;
+local-window blocks stay unbiased, matching training. Scores live in the log2
+domain (``exp2`` softmax), so the natural-log bias is scaled by log2e first.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.unlimited_ocr_dash.common import (
+    _FP8_DTYPES,
+    SPARSE_BLOCK_SIZE,
+    _arch_supports_pdl,
+    _merge_topk_attn_out_kernel,
+)
+
+# Kernels inline log2(e) as 1.4426950409: @triton.jit bodies read only
+# constexpr module globals.
+
+# Split-K target program count for the decode attend.
+TARGET_GRID = 256
+
+# Cache keyed by (device, dtype, graph_owned); grows monotonically to max C/Q
+# geometry so captured graphs never see a reallocated address.
+_DEC_PARTIALS: dict = {}
+
+
+def _max_topk_chunks(chunk_width: int, num_kv_heads: int) -> int:
+    """Largest ``num_topk_chunks`` any batch size can ask for (total_q == 1)."""
+    target = max(1, min(int(chunk_width), TARGET_GRID // max(1, num_kv_heads)))
+    return 1 << (target.bit_length() - 1)
+
+
+def _decode_partials(
+    chunks: int,
+    total_q: int,
+    num_heads: int,
+    head_dim: int,
+    dtype,
+    device,
+    alloc_chunks: int = 0,
+    alloc_rows: int = 0,
+):
+    # Graph-owned storage must never be replaced by an oversized eager fallback.
+    graph_owned = alloc_rows > 0
+    key = (str(device), dtype, graph_owned)
+    cur = _DEC_PARTIALS.get(key)
+    need_c = max(chunks, alloc_chunks)
+    need_q = max(total_q, alloc_rows)
+    if (
+        cur is None
+        or cur[0].shape[0] < need_c
+        or cur[0].shape[1] < need_q
+        or cur[0].shape[2] < num_heads
+        or cur[0].shape[3] < head_dim
+    ):
+        if torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "[Unlimited-OCR v2] decode split-K partials would be (re)allocated during "
+                "cuda graph capture. They must be pre-allocated at the maximum "
+                "geometry on an eager forward by passing cg_rows= to "
+                "dash_sparse_attn_decode."
+            )
+        c = max(need_c, 0 if cur is None else cur[0].shape[0])
+        q_ = max(need_q, 0 if cur is None else cur[0].shape[1])
+        h = max(num_heads, 0 if cur is None else cur[0].shape[2])
+        dd = max(head_dim, 0 if cur is None else cur[0].shape[3])
+        cur = (
+            torch.empty(c, q_, h, dd, dtype=dtype, device=device),
+            torch.empty(c, q_, h, dtype=torch.float32, device=device),
+        )
+        _DEC_PARTIALS[key] = cur
+    o, lse = cur
+    return (
+        o[:chunks, :total_q, :num_heads, :head_dim],
+        lse[:chunks, :total_q, :num_heads],
+    )
+
+
+# Prefill: one program per (query token, kv head, request); BLOCK_SIZE_Q == 1
+# so topk/bias are indexed per query TOKEN.
+@triton.heuristics(
+    {
+        "BLOCK_SIZE_D": lambda args: triton.next_power_of_2(args["head_dim"]),
+        "BLOCK_SIZE_H": lambda args: triton.next_power_of_2(args["gqa_group_size"]),
+        "BLOCK_SIZE_T": lambda args: triton.next_power_of_2(args["max_topk"]),
+        "BLOCK_SIZE_QH": lambda args: (
+            args["BLOCK_SIZE_Q"] * triton.next_power_of_2(args["gqa_group_size"])
+        ),
+    }
+)
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize_on_alignment=["seq_lens", "prefix_lens"])
+def _dash_sparse_fwd_kernel(
+    q_ptr,  # [total_q, num_heads, head_dim]
+    k_cache_ptr,  # [num_pages, page_size, num_kv_heads, head_dim]
+    v_cache_ptr,  # [num_pages, page_size, num_kv_heads, head_dim]
+    t_ptr,  # topk_idx: [num_kv_heads, total_q, topk]
+    b_ptr,  # blk_bias:  [num_kv_heads, total_q, topk] fp32 (log(prior)/sigma)
+    o_ptr,  # [total_q, num_heads, head_dim]
+    block_table_ptr,  # [num_reqs, max_blocks]
+    cu_seqlens_q,
+    cu_seqblocks_q,
+    seq_lens,
+    prefix_lens,
+    num_kv_heads,
+    gqa_group_size,
+    head_dim,
+    max_topk,
+    num_q_loop,
+    sm_scale,
+    stride_qn,
+    stride_qh,
+    stride_qd,
+    stride_kv_blk,
+    stride_kv_pos,
+    stride_kv_h,
+    stride_kv_d,
+    stride_th,
+    stride_tn,
+    stride_tk,
+    stride_bh,
+    stride_bn,
+    stride_bk,
+    stride_on,
+    stride_oh,
+    stride_od,
+    stride_bt_b,
+    BLOCK_SIZE_Q: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_SIZE_K: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_SIZE_D: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_SIZE_H: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_SIZE_T: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_SIZE_QH: tl.constexpr,
+    USE_FP8: tl.constexpr,
+    LOCAL_BLOCKS: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_BIAS: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    sm_scale_log2e = sm_scale * 1.4426950409
+    pid_q = tl.program_id(0)
+    pid_kh = tl.program_id(1)
+    pid_b = tl.program_id(2)
+    q_start = tl.load(cu_seqlens_q + pid_b)
+    q_len = tl.load(cu_seqlens_q + pid_b + 1) - q_start
+    q_block_start = tl.load(cu_seqblocks_q + pid_b)
+    q_block_len = tl.load(cu_seqblocks_q + pid_b + 1) - q_block_start
+    seq_len = tl.load(seq_lens + pid_b)
+    prefix_len = tl.load(prefix_lens + pid_b)
+    if pid_q * num_q_loop >= q_block_len:
+        return
+    real_q_loop = min(num_q_loop, q_block_len - pid_q * num_q_loop)
+    bt_row = block_table_ptr + pid_b * stride_bt_b
+    off_n = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_K)
+    off_d = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_D)
+    d_mask = off_d < head_dim
+    for j in range(real_q_loop):
+        pid_q_j = pid_q * num_q_loop + j
+        off_q = (
+            tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_Q)[:, None]
+            + pid_q_j * BLOCK_SIZE_Q
+            + prefix_len
+            - tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_K)[None, :]
+        )
+        pid_h = pid_kh * gqa_group_size
+        t_ptr_j = t_ptr + (q_block_start + pid_q_j) * stride_tn + pid_kh * stride_th
+        b_ptr_j = b_ptr + (q_block_start + pid_q_j) * stride_bn + pid_kh * stride_bh
+        off_t = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_T)
+        topk_idx = tl.load(t_ptr_j + off_t * stride_tk, mask=off_t < max_topk, other=-1)
+        real_topk = tl.sum((topk_idx >= 0).to(tl.int32), axis=0)
+        q_ptrs = tl.make_block_ptr(
+            base=q_ptr + q_start * stride_qn + pid_h * stride_qh,
+            shape=(q_len, gqa_group_size, head_dim),
+            strides=(stride_qn, stride_qh, stride_qd),
+            offsets=(pid_q_j * BLOCK_SIZE_Q, 0, 0),
+            block_shape=(BLOCK_SIZE_Q, BLOCK_SIZE_H, BLOCK_SIZE_D),
+            order=(2, 1, 0),
+        )
+        q = tl.load(q_ptrs, boundary_check=(0, 1, 2), padding_option="zero")
+        m_i = tl.full((BLOCK_SIZE_QH,), float("-inf"), dtype=tl.float32)
+        lse_i = tl.full((BLOCK_SIZE_QH,), float("-inf"), dtype=tl.float32)
+        acc_o = tl.zeros((BLOCK_SIZE_QH, BLOCK_SIZE_D), dtype=tl.float32)
+        q = tl.reshape(q, BLOCK_SIZE_QH, BLOCK_SIZE_D)
+        for _ in range(real_topk):
+            blk = tl.load(t_ptr_j).to(tl.int32)
+            t_ptr_j = t_ptr_j + stride_tk
+            c = blk * BLOCK_SIZE_K
+            page = tl.load(bt_row + blk).to(tl.int64)
+            pos = c + off_n
+            pos_mask = pos < seq_len
+            k = tl.load(
+                k_cache_ptr
+                + page * stride_kv_blk
+                + off_n[None, :] * stride_kv_pos
+                + pid_kh * stride_kv_h
+                + off_d[:, None] * stride_kv_d,
+                mask=d_mask[:, None] & pos_mask[None, :],
+                other=0.0,
+            )
+            if USE_FP8:
+                k = k.to(q.dtype)
+            qk = tl.zeros((BLOCK_SIZE_Q, BLOCK_SIZE_H, BLOCK_SIZE_K), dtype=tl.float32)
+            # remote blocks contribute only keys strictly BELOW the local window
+            # [q - LW + 1, q]; the window itself is attended in the pass below.
+            qk += tl.where(
+                off_q[:, None, :] >= c + LOCAL_BLOCKS * BLOCK_SIZE_K,
+                0,
+                float("-inf"),
+            )
+            qk = tl.reshape(qk, BLOCK_SIZE_QH, BLOCK_SIZE_K)
+            qk += tl.dot(q, k) * sm_scale_log2e
+            # DASH: per-(query, slot) log(prior)/sigma bias, log2 domain. Masked
+            # lanes stay -inf (-inf + finite == -inf).
+            if HAS_BIAS:
+                blk_bias = tl.load(b_ptr_j).to(tl.float32)
+                qk += blk_bias * 1.4426950409
+            b_ptr_j = b_ptr_j + stride_bk
+            qk += tl.where(pos_mask[None, :], 0, float("-inf"))
+            m_ij = tl.maximum(m_i, tl.max(qk, axis=1))
+            p = tl.exp2(qk - m_ij[:, None])
+            l_ij = tl.sum(p, axis=1)
+            acc_o = acc_o * tl.exp2(m_i - m_ij)[:, None]
+            v = tl.load(
+                v_cache_ptr
+                + page * stride_kv_blk
+                + off_n[:, None] * stride_kv_pos
+                + pid_kh * stride_kv_h
+                + off_d[None, :] * stride_kv_d,
+                mask=pos_mask[:, None] & d_mask[None, :],
+                other=0.0,
+            )
+            if USE_FP8:
+                v = v.to(q.dtype)
+            acc_o += tl.dot(p.to(v.dtype), v)
+            m_i = m_ij
+            lse_i = m_ij + tl.log2(tl.exp2(lse_i - m_ij) + l_ij)
+        # --- token-level local window pass (NO bias, train-parity) ---
+        if LOCAL_BLOCKS > 0:
+            q_pos_scalar = pid_q_j * BLOCK_SIZE_Q + prefix_len
+            b_q_scalar = q_pos_scalar // BLOCK_SIZE_K
+            for local_offset in tl.static_range(LOCAL_BLOCKS + 1):
+                local_blk = b_q_scalar - local_offset
+                if local_blk >= 0:
+                    c_local = local_blk * BLOCK_SIZE_K
+                    page_local = tl.load(bt_row + local_blk).to(tl.int64)
+                    pos_local = c_local + off_n
+                    pos_mask_local = pos_local < seq_len
+                    k_local = tl.load(
+                        k_cache_ptr
+                        + page_local * stride_kv_blk
+                        + off_n[None, :] * stride_kv_pos
+                        + pid_kh * stride_kv_h
+                        + off_d[:, None] * stride_kv_d,
+                        mask=d_mask[:, None] & pos_mask_local[None, :],
+                        other=0.0,
+                    )
+                    if USE_FP8:
+                        k_local = k_local.to(q.dtype)
+                    qk_local = tl.zeros(
+                        (BLOCK_SIZE_Q, BLOCK_SIZE_H, BLOCK_SIZE_K), dtype=tl.float32
+                    )
+                    qk_local += tl.where(
+                        (off_q[:, None, :] >= c_local)
+                        & (
+                            off_q[:, None, :]
+                            <= c_local + LOCAL_BLOCKS * BLOCK_SIZE_K - 1
+                        ),
+                        0,
+                        float("-inf"),
+                    )
+                    qk_local = tl.reshape(qk_local, BLOCK_SIZE_QH, BLOCK_SIZE_K)
+                    qk_local += tl.dot(q, k_local) * sm_scale_log2e
+                    qk_local += tl.where(pos_mask_local[None, :], 0, float("-inf"))
+                    m_ij = tl.maximum(m_i, tl.max(qk_local, axis=1))
+                    p = tl.exp2(qk_local - m_ij[:, None])
+                    l_ij = tl.sum(p, axis=1)
+                    acc_o = acc_o * tl.exp2(m_i - m_ij)[:, None]
+                    v_local = tl.load(
+                        v_cache_ptr
+                        + page_local * stride_kv_blk
+                        + off_n[:, None] * stride_kv_pos
+                        + pid_kh * stride_kv_h
+                        + off_d[None, :] * stride_kv_d,
+                        mask=pos_mask_local[:, None] & d_mask[None, :],
+                        other=0.0,
+                    )
+                    if USE_FP8:
+                        v_local = v_local.to(q.dtype)
+                    acc_o += tl.dot(p.to(v_local.dtype), v_local)
+                    m_i = m_ij
+                    lse_i = m_ij + tl.log2(tl.exp2(lse_i - m_ij) + l_ij)
+        acc_o = acc_o * tl.exp2(m_i - lse_i)[:, None]
+        acc_o = tl.reshape(acc_o, BLOCK_SIZE_Q, BLOCK_SIZE_H, BLOCK_SIZE_D)
+        o_ptrs = tl.make_block_ptr(
+            base=o_ptr + q_start * stride_on + pid_h * stride_oh,
+            shape=(q_len, gqa_group_size, head_dim),
+            strides=(stride_on, stride_oh, stride_od),
+            offsets=(pid_q_j * BLOCK_SIZE_Q, 0, 0),
+            block_shape=(BLOCK_SIZE_Q, BLOCK_SIZE_H, BLOCK_SIZE_D),
+            order=(2, 1, 0),
+        )
+        tl.store(o_ptrs, acc_o.to(o_ptr.dtype.element_ty), boundary_check=(0, 1, 2))
+
+
+# Decode: split-K over the selected blocks (flash-decoding), merged by
+# _merge_topk_attn_out_kernel.
+@triton.heuristics(
+    {
+        "BLOCK_SIZE_H": lambda args: max(
+            16, triton.next_power_of_2(args["gqa_group_size"])
+        ),
+        "BLOCK_SIZE_D": lambda args: triton.next_power_of_2(args["head_dim"]),
+        "BLOCK_SIZE_T": lambda args: triton.next_power_of_2(args["max_topk"]),
+    }
+)
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["decode_query_len"])
+def _dash_sparse_decode_kernel(
+    q_ptr,
+    k_cache_ptr,  # [num_pages, page_size, num_kv_heads, head_dim]
+    v_cache_ptr,  # [num_pages, page_size, num_kv_heads, head_dim]
+    t_ptr,  # topk_idx: [num_kv_heads, total_q, topk]
+    b_ptr,  # blk_bias:  [num_kv_heads, total_q, topk] fp32
+    o_ptr,  # partial out: [NUM_TOPK_CHUNKS, total_q, num_heads, head_dim]
+    lse_ptr,  # partial lse (log2): [NUM_TOPK_CHUNKS, total_q, num_heads]
+    block_table_ptr,
+    seq_lens,
+    total_q,
+    num_kv_heads,
+    gqa_group_size,
+    head_dim,
+    max_topk,
+    sm_scale,
+    decode_query_len,
+    stride_qn,
+    stride_qh,
+    stride_qd,
+    stride_kv_blk,
+    stride_kv_pos,
+    stride_kv_h,
+    stride_kv_d,
+    stride_th,
+    stride_tn,
+    stride_tk,
+    stride_bh,
+    stride_bn,
+    stride_bk,
+    stride_o_c,
+    stride_o_b,
+    stride_o_h,
+    stride_o_d,
+    stride_l_c,
+    stride_l_b,
+    stride_l_h,
+    stride_bt_b,
+    BLOCK_SIZE_K: tl.constexpr,
+    NUM_TOPK_CHUNKS: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_SIZE_H: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_SIZE_D: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_SIZE_T: tl.constexpr,
+    USE_FP8: tl.constexpr,
+    USE_PDL: tl.constexpr,
+    LOCAL_BLOCKS: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_BIAS: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    sm_scale_log2e = sm_scale * 1.4426950409
+    pid_bc = tl.program_id(0)
+    pid_kh = tl.program_id(1)
+    pid_b = pid_bc % total_q
+    pid_c = pid_bc // total_q
+    req_id = pid_b // decode_query_len
+    q_offset = pid_b - req_id * decode_query_len
+
+    if USE_PDL:
+        tl.extra.cuda.gdc_wait()
+
+    seq_len = tl.load(seq_lens + req_id)
+    query_pos = seq_len - decode_query_len + q_offset
+    kv_len = tl.maximum(query_pos + 1, 0)
+    local_win_start = tl.maximum(0, query_pos - LOCAL_BLOCKS * BLOCK_SIZE_K + 1)
+
+    off_t = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_T)
+    off_n = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_K)
+    off_d = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_D)
+    d_mask = off_d < head_dim
+    bt_row = block_table_ptr + req_id * stride_bt_b
+
+    pid_h = pid_kh * gqa_group_size
+    idx_base = t_ptr + pid_kh * stride_th + pid_b * stride_tn
+    bias_base = b_ptr + pid_kh * stride_bh + pid_b * stride_bn
+    topk_idx = tl.load(idx_base + off_t * stride_tk, mask=off_t < max_topk, other=-1)
+    real_topk = tl.sum((topk_idx >= 0).to(tl.int32), axis=0)
+    # Split over the slots the router filled rather than the stable buffer width;
+    # this balances the work across chunks while retaining full coverage.
+    chunk_size_topk = (real_topk + NUM_TOPK_CHUNKS - 1) // NUM_TOPK_CHUNKS
+    chunk_start_topk = pid_c * chunk_size_topk
+    chunk_end_topk = tl.minimum(chunk_start_topk + chunk_size_topk, real_topk)
+
+    m_i = tl.full((BLOCK_SIZE_H,), float("-inf"), dtype=tl.float32)
+    lse_i = tl.full((BLOCK_SIZE_H,), float("-inf"), dtype=tl.float32)
+    acc_o = tl.zeros((BLOCK_SIZE_H, BLOCK_SIZE_D), dtype=tl.float32)
+    q_ptrs = tl.make_block_ptr(
+        base=q_ptr + pid_b * stride_qn + pid_h * stride_qh,
+        shape=(gqa_group_size, head_dim),
+        strides=(stride_qh, stride_qd),
+        offsets=(0, 0),
+        block_shape=(BLOCK_SIZE_H, BLOCK_SIZE_D),
+        order=(1, 0),
+    )
+    q = tl.load(q_ptrs, boundary_check=(0, 1), padding_option="zero")
+
+    cur_idx_ptr = idx_base + chunk_start_topk * stride_tk
+    cur_bias_ptr = bias_base + chunk_start_topk * stride_bk
+    for _ in tl.range(chunk_start_topk, chunk_end_topk):
+        blk = tl.load(cur_idx_ptr).to(tl.int32)
+        cur_idx_ptr = cur_idx_ptr + stride_tk
+        c = blk * BLOCK_SIZE_K
+        page = tl.load(bt_row + blk).to(tl.int64)
+        pos = c + off_n
+        pos_mask = (pos < kv_len) & (pos < local_win_start)
+        k = tl.load(
+            k_cache_ptr
+            + page * stride_kv_blk
+            + off_n[None, :] * stride_kv_pos
+            + pid_kh * stride_kv_h
+            + off_d[:, None] * stride_kv_d,
+            mask=d_mask[:, None] & pos_mask[None, :],
+            other=0.0,
+        )
+        if USE_FP8:
+            k = k.to(q.dtype)
+        qk = tl.zeros((BLOCK_SIZE_H, BLOCK_SIZE_K), dtype=tl.float32)
+        qk += tl.where(pos_mask[None, :], 0, float("-inf"))
+        qk += tl.dot(q, k) * sm_scale_log2e
+        # DASH: per-(query, slot) log(prior)/sigma bias, log2 domain.
+        if HAS_BIAS:
+            blk_bias = tl.load(cur_bias_ptr).to(tl.float32)
+            qk += blk_bias * 1.4426950409
+        cur_bias_ptr = cur_bias_ptr + stride_bk
+        m_ij = tl.maximum(m_i, tl.max(qk, axis=1))
+        p = tl.exp2(qk - m_ij[:, None])
+        l_ij = tl.sum(p, axis=1)
+        acc_o = acc_o * tl.exp2(m_i - m_ij)[:, None]
+        v = tl.load(
+            v_cache_ptr
+            + page * stride_kv_blk
+            + off_n[:, None] * stride_kv_pos
+            + pid_kh * stride_kv_h
+            + off_d[None, :] * stride_kv_d,
+            mask=pos_mask[:, None] & d_mask[None, :],
+            other=0.0,
+        )
+        if USE_FP8:
+            v = v.to(q.dtype)
+        acc_o += tl.dot(p.to(v.dtype), v)
+        m_i = m_ij
+        lse_i = m_ij + tl.log2(tl.exp2(lse_i - m_ij) + l_ij)
+
+    # --- local window pass (chunk 0 only, NO bias) ---
+    if LOCAL_BLOCKS > 0 and pid_c == 0:
+        b_q_scalar = query_pos // BLOCK_SIZE_K
+        for local_offset in tl.static_range(LOCAL_BLOCKS + 1):
+            local_blk = b_q_scalar - local_offset
+            if local_blk >= 0:
+                c_local = local_blk * BLOCK_SIZE_K
+                page_local = tl.load(bt_row + local_blk).to(tl.int64)
+                pos_local = c_local + off_n
+                pos_mask_local = (
+                    (pos_local >= local_win_start)
+                    & (pos_local <= query_pos)
+                    & (pos_local < kv_len)
+                )
+                k_local = tl.load(
+                    k_cache_ptr
+                    + page_local * stride_kv_blk
+                    + off_n[None, :] * stride_kv_pos
+                    + pid_kh * stride_kv_h
+                    + off_d[:, None] * stride_kv_d,
+                    mask=d_mask[:, None] & pos_mask_local[None, :],
+                    other=0.0,
+                )
+                if USE_FP8:
+                    k_local = k_local.to(q.dtype)
+                qk_local = tl.zeros((BLOCK_SIZE_H, BLOCK_SIZE_K), dtype=tl.float32)
+                qk_local += tl.where(pos_mask_local[None, :], 0, float("-inf"))
+                qk_local += tl.dot(q, k_local) * sm_scale_log2e
+                m_ij = tl.maximum(m_i, tl.max(qk_local, axis=1))
+                p = tl.exp2(qk_local - m_ij[:, None])
+                l_ij = tl.sum(p, axis=1)
+                acc_o = acc_o * tl.exp2(m_i - m_ij)[:, None]
+                v_local = tl.load(
+                    v_cache_ptr
+                    + page_local * stride_kv_blk
+                    + off_n[:, None] * stride_kv_pos
+                    + pid_kh * stride_kv_h
+                    + off_d[None, :] * stride_kv_d,
+                    mask=pos_mask_local[:, None] & d_mask[None, :],
+                    other=0.0,
+                )
+                if USE_FP8:
+                    v_local = v_local.to(q.dtype)
+                acc_o += tl.dot(p.to(v_local.dtype), v_local)
+                m_i = m_ij
+                lse_i = m_ij + tl.log2(tl.exp2(lse_i - m_ij) + l_ij)
+
+    scale = tl.where(lse_i > float("-inf"), tl.exp2(m_i - lse_i), tl.zeros_like(lse_i))
+    acc_o = acc_o * scale[:, None]
+    o_ptrs = tl.make_block_ptr(
+        base=o_ptr + pid_c * stride_o_c + pid_b * stride_o_b + pid_h * stride_o_h,
+        shape=(gqa_group_size, head_dim),
+        strides=(stride_o_h, stride_o_d),
+        offsets=(0, 0),
+        block_shape=(BLOCK_SIZE_H, BLOCK_SIZE_D),
+        order=(1, 0),
+    )
+    tl.store(o_ptrs, acc_o.to(o_ptr.dtype.element_ty), boundary_check=(0, 1))
+    lse_ptrs = tl.make_block_ptr(
+        base=lse_ptr + pid_c * stride_l_c + pid_b * stride_l_b + pid_h * stride_l_h,
+        shape=(gqa_group_size,),
+        strides=(stride_l_h,),
+        offsets=(0,),
+        block_shape=(BLOCK_SIZE_H,),
+        order=(0,),
+    )
+    tl.store(lse_ptrs, lse_i, boundary_check=(0,))
+
+    if USE_PDL:
+        tl.extra.cuda.gdc_launch_dependents()
+
+
+# Wrappers; same signature as the sparse ones plus ``blk_bias``.
+@torch.no_grad()
+def dash_sparse_attn(
+    q: torch.Tensor,  # [total_q, num_heads, head_dim]
+    k_cache: torch.Tensor,  # [num_pages, page_size, num_kv_heads, head_dim]
+    v_cache: torch.Tensor,  # [num_pages, page_size, num_kv_heads, head_dim]
+    topk_idx: torch.Tensor,  # [num_kv_heads, total_q, topk] int32
+    blk_bias: torch.Tensor | None,  # [num_kv_heads, total_q, topk] fp32
+    block_table: torch.Tensor,
+    cu_seqlens_q: torch.Tensor,
+    seq_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    prefix_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    max_query_len: int,
+    num_kv_heads: int,
+    sm_scale: float,
+    output: torch.Tensor,
+    local_blocks: int = 0,
+    sparse_block_size: int = SPARSE_BLOCK_SIZE,
+) -> None:
+    """Bias-aware block-sparse prefill attention. block_size_q == 1."""
+    _, num_heads, head_dim = q.shape
+    batch = cu_seqlens_q.shape[0] - 1
+    topk = topk_idx.shape[-1]
+    gqa_group_size = num_heads // num_kv_heads
+    use_fp8 = k_cache.dtype in _FP8_DTYPES
+    has_bias = blk_bias is not None
+    bias_t, b_strides = _bias_operand(blk_bias, topk_idx)
+    grid = (max_query_len, num_kv_heads, batch)
+    _dash_sparse_fwd_kernel[grid](
+        q,
+        k_cache,
+        v_cache,
+        topk_idx,
+        bias_t,
+        output,
+        block_table,
+        cu_seqlens_q,
+        cu_seqlens_q,  # cu_seqblocks_q == cu_seqlens_q when block_size_q == 1
+        seq_lens,
+        prefix_lens,
+        num_kv_heads,
+        gqa_group_size,
+        head_dim,
+        topk,
+        1,  # num_q_loop
+        sm_scale,
+        q.stride(0),
+        q.stride(1),
+        q.stride(2),
+        k_cache.stride(0),
+        k_cache.stride(1),
+        k_cache.stride(2),
+        k_cache.stride(3),
+        topk_idx.stride(0),
+        topk_idx.stride(1),
+        topk_idx.stride(2),
+        b_strides[0],
+        b_strides[1],
+        b_strides[2],
+        output.stride(0),
+        output.stride(1),
+        output.stride(2),
+        block_table.stride(0),

+        LOCAL_BLOCKS=local_blocks,

+def _bias_operand(
+    blk_bias: torch.Tensor | None, topk_idx: torch.Tensor

+    """Bias tensor and strides to launch with; a dummy keeps the signature stable."""
+    if blk_bias is None:
+        return topk_idx.new_zeros(1, dtype=torch.float32), (0, 0, 0)
+    assert blk_bias.shape == topk_idx.shape, (blk_bias.shape, topk_idx.shape)
+    assert blk_bias.dtype == torch.float32, blk_bias.dtype

+    topk_idx,

+    b_strides,
+    o_partial,
+    lse_partial,
+    block_table,
+    seq_lens,
+    num_kv_heads: int,
+    sm_scale: float,
+    decode_query_len: int,
+    num_topk_chunks: int,
+    local_blocks: int,
+    sparse_block_size: int,

+        topk_idx,

+        total_q,
+        num_kv_heads,
+        num_heads // num_kv_heads,
+        head_dim,
+        topk_idx.shape[-1],
+        sm_scale,
+        decode_query_len,
+        q.stride(0),
+        q.stride(1),
+        q.stride(2),
+        k_cache.stride(0),
+        k_cache.stride(1),
+        k_cache.stride(2),
+        k_cache.stride(3),
+        topk_idx.stride(0),
+        topk_idx.stride(1),
+        topk_idx.stride(2),
+        b_strides[0],
+        b_strides[1],
+        b_strides[2],
+        o_partial.stride(0),
+        o_partial.stride(1),
+        o_partial.stride(2),
+        o_partial.stride(3),
+        lse_partial.stride(0),
+        lse_partial.stride(1),
+        lse_partial.stride(2),
+        block_table.stride(0),
+        BLOCK_SIZE_K=sparse_block_size,
+        NUM_TOPK_CHUNKS=num_topk_chunks,
+        USE_FP8=k_cache.dtype in _FP8_DTYPES,
+        USE_PDL=use_pdl,
+        LOCAL_BLOCKS=local_blocks,
+        HAS_BIAS=has_bias,
+        **pdl_launch,
+    )
+
+
+def _launch_merge_partials(
+    *, o_partial, lse_partial, output, num_topk_chunks: int, use_pdl: bool
+) -> None:
+    total_q, num_heads, head_dim = output.shape
+    pdl_launch = {"launch_pdl": True} if use_pdl else {}
+    _merge_topk_attn_out_kernel[(total_q, num_heads)](
+        o_partial,
+        lse_partial,
+        output,
+        head_dim,
+        o_partial.stride(0),
+        o_partial.stride(1),
+        o_partial.stride(2),
+        o_partial.stride(3),
+        lse_partial.stride(0),
+        lse_partial.stride(1),
+        lse_partial.stride(2),
+        output.stride(0),
+        output.stride(1),
+        output.stride(2),
+        NUM_TOPK_CHUNKS=num_topk_chunks,
+        USE_PDL=use_pdl,
+        **pdl_launch,
+    )
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def dash_sparse_attn_decode(
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    k_cache: torch.Tensor,  # [num_pages, page_size, num_kv_heads, head_dim]
+    v_cache: torch.Tensor,  # [num_pages, page_size, num_kv_heads, head_dim]
+    topk_idx: torch.Tensor,
+    blk_bias: torch.Tensor | None,
+    block_table: torch.Tensor,
+    seq_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    num_kv_heads: int,
+    sm_scale: float,
+    output: torch.Tensor,
+    decode_query_len: int,
+    local_blocks: int = 0,
+    sparse_block_size: int = SPARSE_BLOCK_SIZE,
+    chunk_width: int | None = None,
+    cg_rows: int | None = None,
+) -> None:
+    """Bias-aware block-sparse decode with split-K merging.
+
+    ``chunk_width`` keeps the unnarrowed chunk count; ``cg_rows`` preallocates
+    the max CUDA-graph scratch geometry (rows x peak chunks).
+    """
+    total_q, num_heads, head_dim = q.shape
+    assert total_q == seq_lens.shape[0] * decode_query_len

+    num_topk_chunks = _num_topk_chunks(cw, total_q, num_kv_heads)
+    o_partial, lse_partial = _decode_partials(
+        num_topk_chunks,
+        total_q,
+        num_heads,
+        head_dim,
+        q.dtype,
+        q.device,
+        # Max geometry of the capture sweep: chunks peak at total_q == 1, rows
+        # at the largest captured batch.
+        alloc_chunks=0 if not cg_rows else _max_topk_chunks(cw, num_kv_heads),
+        alloc_rows=0 if not cg_rows else int(cg_rows),
+    )
+    _launch_decode_partials(
+        q=q,
+        k_cache=k_cache,
+        v_cache=v_cache,
+        topk_idx=topk_idx,
+        bias_t=bias_t,
+        b_strides=b_strides,
+        o_partial=o_partial,
+        lse_partial=lse_partial,

+        sm_scale=sm_scale,
+        decode_query_len=decode_query_len,
+        num_topk_chunks=num_topk_chunks,
+        local_blocks=local_blocks,
+        sparse_block_size=sparse_block_size,
+        has_bias=blk_bias is not None,
+        use_pdl=use_pdl,
+    )
+    _launch_merge_partials(
+        o_partial=o_partial,
+        lse_partial=lse_partial,
+        output=output,
+        num_topk_chunks=num_topk_chunks,
+        use_pdl=use_pdl,
+    )

+"""Shared DASH attention constants and split-K merge kernel."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+# One sparse block == one KV page. Fallback only; the real value is threaded in
+# as ``sparse_block_size=`` from ``sparse_attention_config`` by every wrapper.
+SPARSE_BLOCK_SIZE = 128
+
+_FP8_DTYPES = (
+    torch.float8_e4m3fn,
+    torch.float8_e4m3fnuz,
+    torch.float8_e5m2,
+    torch.float8_e5m2fnuz,
+)
+
+
+def _compute_pdl_support() -> bool:
+    # PDL (programmatic dependent launch) is an SM90+ Triton launch feature.
+    try:
+        major, _ = torch.cuda.get_device_capability()
+        return major >= 9
+    except Exception:
+        return False
+
+
+_PDL_SUPPORTED: bool | None = None
+
+
+def _arch_supports_pdl() -> bool:
+    global _PDL_SUPPORTED
+    if _PDL_SUPPORTED is None:
+        _PDL_SUPPORTED = _compute_pdl_support()
+    return _PDL_SUPPORTED
+
+
+@triton.heuristics(
+    {"BLOCK_SIZE_D": lambda args: triton.next_power_of_2(args["head_dim"])}
+)
+@triton.jit
+def _merge_topk_attn_out_kernel(
+    o_ptr,  # partials: [NUM_TOPK_CHUNKS, total_q, num_heads, head_dim]
+    lse_ptr,  # partials (log2): [NUM_TOPK_CHUNKS, total_q, num_heads]
+    out_ptr,  # merged out: [total_q, num_heads, head_dim]
+    head_dim,
+    stride_o_c,
+    stride_o_b,
+    stride_o_h,
+    stride_o_d,
+    stride_l_c,
+    stride_l_b,
+    stride_l_h,
+    stride_out_n,
+    stride_out_h,
+    stride_out_d,
+    NUM_TOPK_CHUNKS: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_SIZE_D: tl.constexpr,
+    USE_PDL: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    pid_b, pid_h = tl.program_id(0), tl.program_id(1)
+
+    if USE_PDL:
+        tl.extra.cuda.gdc_wait()
+        tl.extra.cuda.gdc_launch_dependents()
+
+    off_c = tl.arange(0, NUM_TOPK_CHUNKS)
+    off_d = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_D)
+    o_ptrs = tl.make_block_ptr(
+        base=o_ptr + pid_b * stride_o_b + pid_h * stride_o_h,
+        shape=(NUM_TOPK_CHUNKS, head_dim),
+        strides=(stride_o_c, stride_o_d),
+        offsets=(0, 0),
+        block_shape=(NUM_TOPK_CHUNKS, BLOCK_SIZE_D),
+        order=(1, 0),
+    )
+    lse_ptrs = lse_ptr + pid_b * stride_l_b + pid_h * stride_l_h + off_c * stride_l_c
+    o = tl.load(o_ptrs, boundary_check=(0, 1), padding_option="zero")
+    lse = tl.load(lse_ptrs)  # empty chunks contribute -inf -> weight 0
+    lse_max = tl.max(lse, axis=0)
+    weights = tl.exp2(lse - lse_max)
+    weights = weights / tl.sum(weights, axis=0)
+    o_merged = tl.sum(o * weights[:, None], axis=0)
+    out_ptrs = (
+        out_ptr + pid_b * stride_out_n + pid_h * stride_out_h + off_d * stride_out_d
+    )
+    tl.store(out_ptrs, o_merged.to(out_ptr.dtype.element_ty), mask=off_d < head_dim)

+"""Fused one-token decode metadata for page isolation and Page2D RoPE.
+
+One kernel updates page and coordinate state, another builds the candidate mask.
+PyTorch remains the reference, prefill, and multi-token-decode path.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+# Triton @jit bodies may only read module globals created as `tl.constexpr(...)`.
+_MM_PAD_SHIFT = tl.constexpr(1_000_000)
+_INT16_MAX_C = tl.constexpr(32767)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _decode_meta_kernel(
+    ids_ptr,  # [R] int64/int32  this step's token per request
+    bt_ptr,  # [R, W] int64     logical -> physical page
+    seq_ptr,  # [R] int32        sequence length INCLUDING this token
+    slot_ptr,  # [R] int64        KV slot this token was written to
+    row_ptr,  # [R] int64        coordinate-state row of the request
+    # page-isolation per-slot state
+    s_page_ptr,
+    s_mark_ptr,
+    s_run_ptr,
+    s_pp_ptr,
+    # coordinate per-row state
+    c_mark_ptr,
+    c_pp_ptr,
+    c_cnt_ptr,
+    # outputs
+    q_page_ptr,  # [R] int32
+    tok_ptr,  # [R] int64
+    page_ptr,  # [R] int64
+    stride_bt_r,
+    stride_cnt_r,
+    image_token_id,
+    page_token_id,
+    per_page,
+    n_slots,
+    max_pages,
+    bt_w,
+    HAS_MARKER: tl.constexpr,
+    BS: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    r = tl.program_id(0)
+    tok_id = tl.load(ids_ptr + r)
+    is_img = (tok_id >= _MM_PAD_SHIFT) | (tok_id == image_token_id)
+    if HAS_MARKER:
+        is_mark = tok_id == page_token_id
+    else:
+        is_mark = False
+
+    seq = tl.load(seq_ptr + r).to(tl.int32)
+    # --- carry-in: the slot holding this request's PREVIOUS token -------------
+    prev_pos = seq - 2  # seq includes this token
+    valid = prev_pos >= 0
+    p = tl.maximum(prev_pos, 0)
+    blk = tl.minimum(p // BS, bt_w - 1)
+    phys = tl.load(bt_ptr + r * stride_bt_r + blk).to(tl.int64)
+    prev_slot = tl.minimum(tl.maximum(phys * BS + (p % BS), 0), n_slots - 1)
+    prev_slot = tl.where(valid, prev_slot, 0)
+    prev_m = tl.where(valid, tl.load(s_mark_ptr + prev_slot), 0).to(tl.int32)
+    prev_i = tl.where(valid, tl.load(s_run_ptr + prev_slot), 0).to(tl.int32)
+    prev_pp = tl.where(valid, tl.load(s_pp_ptr + prev_slot), 0).to(tl.int32)
+
+    marker_cum = prev_m + is_mark.to(tl.int32)
+    img_run = prev_i + is_img.to(tl.int32)
+
+    # --- page attribution (page_state.step, decode branch) -------------------
+    img_page = tl.where(marker_cum > 0, marker_cum - 1, (img_run - 1) // per_page)
+    img_page = tl.where(is_img, img_page, -1)
+    pp = tl.maximum(tl.where(is_img, marker_cum, 0), prev_pp)
+    # Decode tokens always take the RESPONSE numbering (raw - prompt_pages).
+    resp = marker_cum - 1 - pp
+    resp = tl.where(resp >= 0, resp, -1)
+    q_page = tl.where(is_img, img_page, resp)
+    tl.store(q_page_ptr + r, q_page)
+
+    # --- per-slot writes -----------------------------------------------------
+    slot = tl.minimum(tl.maximum(tl.load(slot_ptr + r), 0), n_slots - 1)
+    tl.store(s_page_ptr + slot, img_page)
+    tl.store(s_mark_ptr + slot, marker_cum)
+    tl.store(s_run_ptr + slot, img_run)
+    tl.store(s_pp_ptr + slot, pp)
+
+    # Clear unused slots in the final partial KV block; stale image-page state
+    # could otherwise misclassify the newest block.
+    last_blk = tl.minimum(tl.maximum((seq - 1) // BS, 0), bt_w - 1)
+    tail_phys = tl.load(bt_ptr + r * stride_bt_r + last_blk).to(tl.int64)
+    rem = seq % BS
+    off_b = tl.arange(0, BS)
+    stale = (off_b >= rem) & (rem > 0)
+    tail = tl.minimum(tl.maximum(tail_phys * BS + off_b, 0), n_slots - 1)
+    tl.store(s_page_ptr + tail, tl.full((BS,), -1, tl.int32), mask=stale)
+
+    # --- page2d coordinates (page2d_rope.step, decode branch) ----------------
+    row = tl.load(row_ptr + r)
+    c_m = tl.load(c_mark_ptr + row).to(tl.int32) + is_mark.to(tl.int32)
+    c_p = tl.maximum(tl.where(is_img, c_m, 0), tl.load(c_pp_ptr + row).to(tl.int32))
+    # An extra generated <PAGE> stays on the last real page, as in training.
+    c_resp = tl.minimum(tl.maximum(c_m - c_p, 0), c_p)
+    cpage = tl.minimum(tl.maximum(c_resp, 0), max_pages - 1).to(tl.int64)
+    cnt_at = tl.load(c_cnt_ptr + row * stride_cnt_r + cpage).to(tl.int64)
+    # This step contributes exactly one token to that page bucket, so the
+    # running count IS the token's coordinate (inc == 1 -> cnt + 1 - 1).
+    tl.store(tok_ptr + r, cnt_at)
+    tl.store(page_ptr + r, cpage)
+    tl.store(c_cnt_ptr + row * stride_cnt_r + cpage, (cnt_at + 1).to(tl.int32))
+    tl.store(c_mark_ptr + row, c_m)
+    tl.store(c_pp_ptr + row, c_p)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _decode_allow_kernel(
+    bt_ptr,  # [R, W] int64
+    s_page_ptr,  # [n_slots] int32   per-slot image page id (-1 == none)
+    q_page_ptr,  # [R] int32
+    seq_ptr,  # [R] int32         sequence length INCLUDING this token
+    out_ptr,  # [R, max_block] int8
+    stride_bt_r,
+    stride_out_r,
+    W,
+    num_blocks,
+    max_block,
+    BS: tl.constexpr,
+    CHUNK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """Build ``allow = same_page | open_row``; needs a full-row reduction, so two scans.
+
+    Scans stop at the live sequence length because fixed-width graph tables may
+    contain stale columns from other requests.
+    """
+    r = tl.program_id(0)
+    qp = tl.load(q_page_ptr + r).to(tl.int32)
+    seq = tl.load(seq_ptr + r).to(tl.int32)
+    off_c = tl.arange(0, CHUNK)
+    off_b = tl.arange(0, BS)
+
+    # Count matches explicitly; Python ``not`` does not negate a Triton scalar.
+    n_same = tl.zeros((), dtype=tl.int32)

+    page_ptr,  # [T] int

+    inv_page_ptr,  # [PAGE_PAIRS] fp32

+from __future__ import annotations

+import torch

+def _rope2d_torch(
+    x: torch.Tensor, cos: torch.Tensor, sin: torch.Tensor, head_dim: int
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    t = x.shape[0]
+    v = x.view(t, -1, head_dim)
+    x1 = v[..., : head_dim // 2]
+    x2 = v[..., head_dim // 2 :]
+    rot = torch.cat((-x2, x1), dim=-1)
+    # Same dtype as training: cos/sin are built in fp32 and cast down before the
+    # multiply, so the rotation itself runs in the model dtype.
+    out = v * cos[:, None, :] + rot * sin[:, None, :]
+    return out.view_as(x)
+
+
+_rope_kernel = None
+_rope_kernel_pair = None
+

+def _get_rope_kernel():
+    """Lazily built so this module still imports with torch alone (CPU parity tool)."""
+    global _rope_kernel
+    if _rope_kernel is None:
+        import triton
+        import triton.language as tl
+
+        @triton.jit
+        def _k(
+            x_ptr,
+            o_ptr,
+            cos_ptr,
+            sin_ptr,
+            n_heads,
+            sx,
+            sc,
+            HD: tl.constexpr,
+            HALF: tl.constexpr,
+        ):
+            pid = tl.program_id(0)
+            row = pid // n_heads
+            head = pid % n_heads
+            base = row * sx + head * HD
+            d = tl.arange(0, HD)
+            xp = x_ptr + base + d
+            x = tl.load(xp)
+            # rotate_half: rot = cat(-x2, x1)
+            other = tl.where(d < HALF, d + HALF, d - HALF)
+            xo = tl.load(x_ptr + base + other)
+            rot = tl.where(d < HALF, -xo, xo)
+            c = tl.load(cos_ptr + row * sc + d)
+            s = tl.load(sin_ptr + row * sc + d)
+            # Match PyTorch bf16 by rounding each multiply before the add.
+            # Integer-domain RTNE prevents truncation and fp32 fusion.
+            v = x.to(tl.float32) * c.to(tl.float32)
+            u = v.to(tl.uint32, bitcast=True)
+            u = u + 0x7FFF + ((u >> 16) & 1)
+            t1 = (u & 0xFFFF0000).to(tl.float32, bitcast=True)
+            v = rot.to(tl.float32) * s.to(tl.float32)
+            u = v.to(tl.uint32, bitcast=True)
+            u = u + 0x7FFF + ((u >> 16) & 1)
+            t2 = (u & 0xFFFF0000).to(tl.float32, bitcast=True)
+            v = t1 + t2
+            u = v.to(tl.uint32, bitcast=True)
+            u = u + 0x7FFF + ((u >> 16) & 1)
+            # The low 16 bits are already zero, so this last cast is exact.
+            o = (u & 0xFFFF0000).to(tl.float32, bitcast=True).to(x.dtype)
+            tl.store(o_ptr + base + d, o)

+def apply_page2d_rope(
+    x: torch.Tensor, cos: torch.Tensor, sin: torch.Tensor, head_dim: int

+    """Apply NeoX RoPE to ``[T, H * head_dim]``.
+
+    Eligible bf16 layouts use a bit-identical fused Triton kernel; other dtypes
+    and layouts use the PyTorch path.
+    """

+        x.is_cuda
+        and x.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        and t > 0
+        and x.is_contiguous()
+        and cos.is_contiguous()
+        and sin.is_contiguous()
+        and cos.dtype == x.dtype
+        and sin.dtype == x.dtype
+        and cos.shape == (t, head_dim)
+        and sin.shape == (t, head_dim)
+        and head_dim >= 2
+        and head_dim & (head_dim - 1) == 0
+        and x.shape[1] % head_dim == 0

+        sin,

+        cos.stride(0),
+        HD=head_dim,
+        HALF=head_dim // 2,

+            oy_ptr,

+                    crow,

+        and y.shape[0] == t
