+        return pages
+
+    def get_attention_sliding_window_size(self) -> Optional[int]:
+        """Use a full KV pool; DASH applies its local window in the kernel."""
+        return None
+
+    def is_prefill_aware_swa(self) -> bool:
+        """No prefill-aware SWA: see ``get_attention_sliding_window_size``."""
+        return False
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        forward_batch: ForwardBatch,
+        **kwargs: object,
+    ):
+        """Route through the shared multimodal embedding + language model path."""
+        return general_mm_embed_routine(
+            input_ids=input_ids,
+            forward_batch=forward_batch,
+            language_model=self.model,
+            multimodal_model=self,
+            data_embedding_funcs={Modality.IMAGE: self.early_embeddings},
+            positions=positions,
+        )
+
+    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[Tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]):
+        """Remap checkpoint keys (see ``_rewrite_v2_names``) and load all params."""
+        clear_sam_rel_pos_cache()
+        # Only the MLP is fused; attention keeps separate q/k/v (see __init__).
+        stacked_params_mapping = [
+            (".gate_up_proj", ".gate_proj", 0),
+            (".gate_up_proj", ".up_proj", 1),
+        ]
+        params_dict = dict(self.named_parameters())
+        loaded_params: Set[str] = set()
+        shadowed = 0
+        dash_layers: Set[str] = set()
+
+        for name, loaded_weight in _rewrite_v2_names(weights, dash_layers):
+            if name == "__shadowed__":
+                shadowed += 1
+                continue
+            for param_name, weight_name, shard_id in stacked_params_mapping:
+                if weight_name not in name:
+                    continue
+                name = name.replace(weight_name, param_name)
+                if name.endswith(".bias") and name not in params_dict:
+                    continue
+                if (
+                    "mlp.experts." in name or "mlp.shared_experts." in name
+                ) and name not in params_dict:
+                    continue
+                param = params_dict[name]
+                param.weight_loader(param, loaded_weight, shard_id)
+                break
+            else:
+                if name.endswith(".bias") and name not in params_dict:
+                    continue
+                if (
+                    "mlp.experts." in name or "mlp.shared_experts." in name
+                ) and name not in params_dict:
+                    continue
+                param = params_dict[name]
+                weight_loader = getattr(param, "weight_loader", default_weight_loader)
+                weight_loader(param, loaded_weight)
+            loaded_params.add(name)
+
+        unloaded = params_dict.keys() - loaded_params
+        if unloaded:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"Some weights are not initialized from checkpoints: {unloaded}"
+            )
+        logger.info(
+            "[Unlimited-OCR v2] loaded %d DASH router layers; dropped %d indexer "
+            "tensors shadowed by dash_router weights",
+            len(dash_layers),
+            shadowed,
+        )
+        self.post_load_weights()
+
+    def post_load_weights(self):
+        """CPU-AMX repacking for the MoE experts; no-op on GPU."""
+        from sglang.srt.utils import cpu_has_amx_support, is_cpu
+
+        if not (is_cpu() and cpu_has_amx_support()):
+            return
+        from sglang.srt.layers.amx_utils import _amx_process_weight_after_loading
+
+        layer_ids = int(self.config.num_hidden_layers)
+        first_k_dense_replace = getattr(self.config, "first_k_dense_replace", -1)
+        moe_layer_freq = getattr(self.config, "moe_layer_freq", 1)
+        for layer_id in range(layer_ids):
+            if layer_id >= first_k_dense_replace and layer_id % moe_layer_freq == 0:
+                moe = self.model.model.layers[layer_id].mlp
+                if hasattr(moe, "w1") and hasattr(moe, "w2"):
+                    _amx_process_weight_after_loading(moe, ["w1", "w2"])
+
+
+def _rewrite_v2_names(
+    weights: Iterable[Tuple[str, torch.Tensor]], dash_layers: Set[str]
+) -> Iterable[Tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]:
+    """Map v2 checkpoint keys onto the runtime module tree.
+
+    Drops zeroed ``indexer`` keys that would clobber trained ``dash_router``
+    weights and optional ``mtp`` tensors; vision keys stay top-level,
+    language-model keys gain one ``model.`` prefix.
+    """
+    for name, weight in weights:
+        if "rotary_emb.inv_freq" in name:
+            continue
+        if name.startswith("mtp."):
+            continue
+        # The CLIP tower saved `position_ids` as a persistent buffer; newer
+        # transformers registers it non-persistently, so it has no parameter.
+        if name.endswith("embeddings.position_ids"):
+            continue
+
+        router, _, tail = name.partition(".self_attn.dash_router.")
+        if tail:
+            dash_layers.add(router)
+            if tail == "head_cls":
+                yield _lm_prefix(f"{router}.self_attn.head_cls"), weight
+            else:
+                yield _lm_prefix(f"{router}.self_attn.index_{tail}"), weight
+            continue
+
+        idx, _, tail = name.partition(".self_attn.indexer.")
+        if tail:
+            if idx in dash_layers:
+                yield "__shadowed__", weight
+                continue
+            yield _lm_prefix(f"{idx}.self_attn.index_{tail}"), weight
+            continue
+
+        if name == "lm_head.weight":
+            yield "model.lm_head.weight", weight
+            continue
+        yield _lm_prefix(name), weight
+
+
+_VISION_KEYS = (
+    "image_newline",
+    ".projector",
+    "vision_model",
+    "sam_model",
+    "view_seperator",
+)
+
+
+def _lm_prefix(name: str) -> str:
+    """Add the extra `model.` level the LM tower needs; vision keys lose theirs."""
+    if not name.startswith("model."):
+        return name
+    if any(key in name for key in _VISION_KEYS):
+        return name[len("model.") :]
+    return name.replace("model.", "model.model.", 1)
+
+
+EntryClass = [UnlimitedOCRV2ForCausalLM]

+"""Materialize shared-memory request data outside the scheduler thread."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections import deque
+from concurrent.futures import Future, ThreadPoolExecutor, wait
+from math import prod
+from threading import Lock
+from typing import Callable, Optional
+
+import msgspec
+
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.managers.io_struct import (
+    BaseBatchReq,
+    TokenizedEmbeddingReqInput,
+    TokenizedGenerateReqInput,
+)
+from sglang.srt.managers.mm_utils import ShmPointerMMData
+from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import (
+    MultimodalInputs,
+    MultimodalProcessorOutput,
+)
+from sglang.srt.utils.nvtx_utils import operations_nvtx_range
+
+# Received values (SHM-backed or not) queued for in-order publication.
+_MAX_ITEMS = 64
+# Values one poll receives under an unbounded scheduler poll; half the queue
+# leaves room for local aborts and entries still pending from the last poll.
+_RECV_BATCH = _MAX_ITEMS // 2
+# Threads materializing SHM segments.
+_WORKERS = 1
+
+
+class AsyncShmEntry(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):
+    """Store one FIFO entry and its materialization future."""
+
+    value: object
+    size: int
+    future: Optional[Future]
+
+
+class AsyncShmStats(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):
+    """Report async SHM queue and resource usage."""
+
+    submitted: int
+    fallbacks: int
+    active_items: int
+    active_bytes: int
+    max_active_items: int
+    max_active_bytes: int
+    pending_entries: int
+
+
+def _validate_positive(name: str, value: int) -> int:
+    if value <= 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be positive")
+    return value
+
+
+class AsyncShmMaterializer:
+    """Materialize SHM entries asynchronously and publish them in FIFO order."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        max_recv_per_poll: int,
+        discard: Callable[[object], None],
+        max_items: int = _MAX_ITEMS,
+        workers: int = _WORKERS,
+    ) -> None:
+        # The request receiver stops each poll at this many values.
+        self.max_recv_per_poll = _validate_positive(
+            "max_recv_per_poll", max_recv_per_poll
+        )
+        self.max_items = _validate_positive("max_items", max_items)
+        self.max_bytes = (
+            _validate_positive(
+                "SGLANG_UOCR_ASYNC_SHM_MAX_MB",
+                envs.SGLANG_UOCR_ASYNC_SHM_MAX_MB.get(),
+            )
+            * 1024
+            * 1024
+        )
+        if self.max_recv_per_poll > self.max_items:
+            raise ValueError("max_recv_per_poll must not exceed max_items")
+        workers = _validate_positive("workers", workers)
+        self.discard = discard
+        self.entries = deque()
+        self.active_items = 0
+        self.active_bytes = 0
+        self.max_active_items = 0
+        self.max_active_bytes = 0
+        self.submitted = 0
+        self.fallbacks = 0
+        self.receive_reservation = 0
+        self.closing = False
+        self.lock = Lock()
+        self.executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(
+            max_workers=workers,
+            thread_name_prefix="uocr-shm-materialize",
+        )
+
+    def reserve_receive(self, *, extra_items: int = 0) -> bool:
+        """Reserve bounded queue capacity before receiving requests."""
+        if extra_items < 0:
+            raise ValueError("extra_items must be nonnegative")
+        with self.lock:
+            if self.closing or self.receive_reservation:
+                return False
+            reservation = self.max_recv_per_poll + extra_items
+            if len(self.entries) + reservation > self.max_items:
+                return False
+            self.receive_reservation = reservation
+            return True
+
+    def receive_reserved(self) -> bool:
+        """Return whether a receive reservation is active."""
+        with self.lock:
+            return self.receive_reservation > 0
+
+    def has_pending(self) -> bool:
+        """Return whether received values are still queued for publication."""
+        with self.lock:
+            return bool(self.entries)
+
+    def wait_for_progress(self) -> None:
+        """Briefly yield the scheduler while the FIFO head materializes."""
+        with self.lock:
+            future = self.entries[0].future if self.entries else None
+        if future is not None:
+            wait((future,), timeout=0.001)
+
+    def cancel_receive(self) -> None:
+        """Cancel the active receive reservation."""
+        with self.lock:
+            self.receive_reservation = 0
+
+    def submit(
+        self,
+        values,
+        *,
+        finalize: Callable[[list], None],
+        has_shm: Callable[[list], bool],
+    ) -> None:
+        """Submit received values while preserving top-level FIFO order."""
+        values = tuple(values)
+        with self.lock:
+            if self.closing:
+                self.receive_reservation = 0
+                raise RuntimeError("async SHM materializer is closed")
+            if not self.receive_reservation:
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    "async SHM materializer requires a receive reservation"
+                )
+            if len(values) > self.receive_reservation:
+                self.receive_reservation = 0
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    "async SHM materializer receive reservation exceeded"
+                )
+            if len(self.entries) + len(values) > self.max_items:
+                self.receive_reservation = 0
+                raise RuntimeError("async SHM materializer item reservation exceeded")
+            self.receive_reservation = 0
+            for value in values:
+                if not has_shm([value]):
+                    self.entries.append(AsyncShmEntry(value, 0, None))
+                    continue
+                size = estimate_shm_bytes(value)
+                if (
+                    self.active_items >= self.max_items
+                    or self.active_bytes + size > self.max_bytes
+                ):
+                    with operations_nvtx_range("uocr.async_shm.fallback"):
+                        finalize([value])
+                    self.fallbacks += 1
+                    self.entries.append(AsyncShmEntry(value, 0, None))
+                    continue
+                with operations_nvtx_range("uocr.async_shm.submit"):
+                    future = self.executor.submit(self._run, finalize, value)
+                self.active_items += 1
+                self.active_bytes += size
+                self.submitted += 1
+                self.max_active_items = max(self.max_active_items, self.active_items)
+                self.max_active_bytes = max(self.max_active_bytes, self.active_bytes)
+                self.entries.append(AsyncShmEntry(value, size, future))
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _run(finalize: Callable[[list], None], value) -> None:
+        with operations_nvtx_range("uocr.async_shm.worker"):
+            finalize([value])
+
+    def pop_ready(self) -> list:
+        """Pop the contiguous completed prefix from the FIFO queue."""
+        ready = []
+        with operations_nvtx_range("uocr.async_shm.ready"):
+            with self.lock:
+                while self.entries:
+                    entry = self.entries[0]
+                    if entry.future is not None and not entry.future.done():
+                        break
+                    self.entries.popleft()
+                    if entry.future is not None:
+                        self.active_items -= 1
+                        self.active_bytes -= entry.size
+                        try:
+                            entry.future.result()
+                        except BaseException:
+                            self.discard(entry.value)
+                            raise
+                    ready.append(entry.value)
+        return ready
+
+    def stats(self) -> AsyncShmStats:
+        """Return a snapshot of queue and resource counters."""
+        with self.lock:
+            return AsyncShmStats(
+                submitted=self.submitted,
+                fallbacks=self.fallbacks,
+                active_items=self.active_items,
+                active_bytes=self.active_bytes,
+                max_active_items=self.max_active_items,
+                max_active_bytes=self.max_active_bytes,
+                pending_entries=len(self.entries),
+            )
+
+    def shutdown(self) -> None:
+        """Stop submissions and release all queued SHM entries."""
+        with self.lock:
+            if self.closing:
+                return
+            self.closing = True
+            self.receive_reservation = 0
+            entries = tuple(self.entries)
+            for entry in entries:
+                if entry.future is not None:
+                    entry.future.cancel()
+        self.executor.shutdown(wait=True, cancel_futures=True)
+        with self.lock:
+            self.entries.clear()
+            for entry in entries:
+                if entry.future is None:
+                    continue
+                if entry.future.cancelled():
+                    self.discard(entry.value)
+                    continue
+                try:
+                    entry.future.result()
+                except BaseException:
+                    self.discard(entry.value)
+            self.active_items = 0
+            self.active_bytes = 0
+
+
+def create_async_shm_materializer(
+    *,
+    max_recv_per_poll: int,
+    tp_size: int,
+    pp_size: int,
+    dp_size: int,
+    attn_cp_size: int,
+    nnodes: int,
+    mm_feature_transport: Optional[str],
+    scripted_runtime: bool,
+    rust_server: bool,
+    is_unlimited_ocr: bool,
+) -> Optional[AsyncShmMaterializer]:
+    """Create the materializer only for supported bounded configurations.
+
+    A negative ``max_recv_per_poll`` (unbounded scheduler polls) receives
+    ``_RECV_BATCH`` values per poll instead; other models keep their polls.
+    """
+    if not envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_UOCR_ASYNC_SHM_MATERIALIZATION.get():
+        return None
+    recv_batch = _RECV_BATCH if max_recv_per_poll < 0 else max_recv_per_poll
+    if (
+        not is_unlimited_ocr
+        or recv_batch == 0
+        or recv_batch > _MAX_ITEMS
+        or tp_size != 1
+        or pp_size != 1
+        or dp_size != 1
+        or attn_cp_size != 1
+        or nnodes != 1
+        or mm_feature_transport != "cpu"
+        or scripted_runtime
+        or rust_server
+    ):
+        return None
+    from sglang.srt.managers.mm_utils import discard_shm_features
+
+    return AsyncShmMaterializer(
+        max_recv_per_poll=recv_batch,
+        discard=discard_shm_features,
+    )
+
+
+def _pointer_bytes(candidate, pointers: dict[str, int]) -> None:
+    values = candidate if isinstance(candidate, (list, tuple)) else (candidate,)
+    for value in values:
+        if isinstance(value, ShmPointerMMData):
+            pointers[value.shm_name] = prod(value.shape) * value.dtype.itemsize
+
+
+def estimate_shm_bytes(value) -> int:
+    """Estimate unique logical SHM bytes owned by one top-level value."""
+    pointers: dict[str, int] = {}
+    requests = value.batch if isinstance(value, BaseBatchReq) else (value,)
+    for request in requests:
+        if not isinstance(
+            request, (TokenizedGenerateReqInput, TokenizedEmbeddingReqInput)
+        ):
+            continue
+        if not isinstance(
+            request.mm_inputs, (MultimodalProcessorOutput, MultimodalInputs)
+        ):
+            continue
+        for item in request.mm_inputs.mm_items:
+            _pointer_bytes(item.feature, pointers)
+            _pointer_bytes(item.precomputed_embeddings, pointers)
+            if item.model_specific_data is not None:
+                for candidate in item.model_specific_data.values():
+                    _pointer_bytes(candidate, pointers)
+    return sum(pointers.values())

+"""Serve Unlimited-OCR v2 multi-page documents as a chain of page windows.
+
+Each window is an ordinary chat request over a contiguous page range; the
+scheduler splices the previous window's KV tail into it, and the answers are
+concatenated by page ownership.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+import functools
+import logging
+import time
+import uuid
+from http import HTTPStatus
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Callable, Optional
+
+import msgspec
+import orjson
+from fastapi.responses import ORJSONResponse, StreamingResponse
+
+from sglang.srt.configs.model_config import UNLIMITED_OCR_V2_ARCH
+from sglang.srt.configs.unlimited_ocr import merge_mm_processor_kwargs
+from sglang.srt.configs.unlimited_ocr_v2 import (
+    DEFAULT_LOOKAHEAD_PAGES,
+    UocrDocumentConfig,
+)
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.protocol import (
+    ChatCompletionResponse,
+    ChatCompletionStreamResponse,
+    PromptTokensDetails,
+    UsageInfo,
+)
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.sse_utils import build_sse_content
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.usage_processor import UsageProcessor
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.utils import should_include_usage
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.models.unlimited_ocr_v2_support import (
+    document_prefetch as uocr_doc_prefetch,
+)
+from sglang.srt.models.unlimited_ocr_v2_support import document_reuse as uocr_doc_reuse
+from sglang.srt.models.unlimited_ocr_v2_support import document_split as doc_split
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_mm, get_serving
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.serving_chat import OpenAIServingChat
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+def _is_context_error_message(message: str) -> bool:
+    """Whether a rejection means the window did not fit the context."""
+    return any(
+        marker in message
+        for marker in (
+            "longer than the model's context length",
+            "exceeds the model's maximum context length",
+            "Multimodal prompt is too long after expanding multimodal tokens",
+            "exceeds the maximum allowed length",
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def _is_doc_split_context_error(response) -> bool:
+    if not isinstance(response, ORJSONResponse) or response.status_code != 400:
+        return False
+    try:
+        message = orjson.loads(response.body).get("message", "")
+    except orjson.JSONDecodeError:
+        return False
+    return _is_context_error_message(message)
+
+
+class _PrefetchedStream:
+    """An async iterator whose first step can be run ahead of consumption.
+
+    ``start`` drives the wrapped generator up to its first chunk, which sends
+    the window's request (tokenisation included); the chunk is replayed first.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, agen):
+        self._agen = agen
+        self._task = None
+
+    async def start(self) -> None:
+        """Run the wrapped generator up to its first chunk, in the background."""
+        if self._task is None:
+            self._task = asyncio.ensure_future(self._agen.__anext__())
+
+    def __aiter__(self):
+        return self
+
+    async def __anext__(self):
+        if self._task is not None:
+            task, self._task = self._task, None
+            return await task
+        return await self._agen.__anext__()
+
+    async def aclose(self) -> None:
+        if self._task is not None:
+            task, self._task = self._task, None
+            task.cancel()
+            await asyncio.gather(task, return_exceptions=True)
+        await self._agen.aclose()
+
+
+class _WindowStream(msgspec.Struct):
+    """One streaming doc-split window: decoded text and what was sent of it."""
+
+    text: str = ""
+    sent: str = ""
+    reused: bool = False
+    meta: dict = {}
+
+
+def _window_pages(reused: bool, *, lo: int, hi: int, emit_from: int) -> dict:
+    """Ownership arguments of ``doc_split.select_batch_output`` for one window.
+
+    A reused window hides its spliced text, so its answer opens with the body
+    of its own first page; a recomputed one leads with the overlap pages.
+    """
+    if reused:
+        return {
+            "input_pages": hi - emit_from,
+            "context_pages": 0,
+            "leads_with_body": True,
+        }
+    return {
+        "input_pages": hi - lo,
+        "context_pages": emit_from - lo,
+        "leads_with_body": False,
+    }
+
+
+def _images_config(request) -> dict:
+    """The images_config the Unlimited-OCR v2 processor resolves for ``request``."""
+    return (
+        merge_mm_processor_kwargs(request.images_config, request.mm_processor_kwargs)
+        or {}
+    )
+
+
+def _doc_image_mode(request) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Image mode a split document's windows use, from its images_config."""
+    cfg = _images_config(request)
+    if "image_mode" in cfg:
+        return cfg["image_mode"] or "gundam"
+    if cfg.get("crop_mode") is not None:
+        return "gundam" if cfg["crop_mode"] else "base"
+    return None
+
+
+def _window_lookahead(request, plan, bi) -> int:
+    """Pages window ``bi`` reads past its own: the next windows' first pages.
+
+    The last window has nothing after it. The plan's windows are
+    contiguous, so the next one starts at this window's ``hi``.
+    """
+    if bi >= len(plan) - 1:
+        return 0
+    _, hi, _ = plan[bi]
+    _, last_hi, _ = plan[-1]
+    options = request.doc_split_options
+    lookahead = (
+        options.lookahead_pages
+        if options is not None and options.lookahead_pages is not None
+        else DEFAULT_LOOKAHEAD_PAGES
+    )
+    return min(lookahead, last_hi - hi)
+
+
+def _estimate_window_capacity(request, plan, bi, *, context_length, image_mode) -> int:
+    """Completion tokens window ``bi`` may ask for: context room, page-capped.
+
+    The page guard bounds what a window writes, so asking for that keeps
+    input plus ``max_new_tokens`` under the context even when its pages run
+    longer than the per-page estimate. The cap is the one the guard applies,
+    which a request may name itself.
+    """
+    lo, hi, _ = plan[bi]
+    capacity = doc_split.completion_capacity(
+        context_length=context_length,
+        image_mode=image_mode,
+        input_pages=hi - lo + _window_lookahead(request, plan, bi),
+    )
+    params = dict(request.custom_params or {})
+    options = request.doc_split_options
+    if options is not None and options.max_page_tokens is not None:
+        params["max_page_tokens"] = options.max_page_tokens
+    page_tokens = doc_split.effective_max_page_tokens(
+        server_max_page_tokens=get_mm().uocr_max_page_tokens,
+        custom_params=params,
+    )
+    cap = doc_split.window_output_cap(own_pages=hi - lo, max_page_tokens=page_tokens)
+    return capacity if cap is None else min(capacity, cap)
+
+
+def _window_request(
+    request,
+    *,
+    hf_config,
+    plan,
+    bi,
+    max_tokens,
+    doc_reuse_id,
+    after=None,
+    remaining=None,
+):
+    """owned child request with page guard, reuse and optional predecessor metadata"""
+    lo, hi, emit_from = plan[bi]
+    lookahead = _window_lookahead(request, plan, bi)
+    sub = request.model_copy(deep=True)
+    sub.messages = doc_split.split_messages(sub.messages, lo, hi + lookahead)
+    # Whether the scheduler reused the previous window's KV only shows up in
+    # meta_info; the parent's own flag is restored before it responds.
+    sub.return_meta_info = True
+    if request.max_completion_tokens is not None:
+        sub.max_completion_tokens = max_tokens
+        sub.max_tokens = None
+    else:
+        sub.max_tokens = max_tokens
+        sub.max_completion_tokens = None
+    # Every split window, reused or recomputed, numbers RoPE pages globally.
+    sub.custom_params = {
+        **(sub.custom_params or {}),
+        uocr_doc_reuse.KEY_PAGE_BASE: lo,
+        uocr_doc_reuse.KEY_LOOKAHEAD: lookahead,
+    }
+    # A follow-up window may be reused without an instruction, and a window
+    # with a lookahead page must stop before transcribing it; either way only
+    # the page guard can stop it, whatever the length threshold.
+    _apply_page_cap(
+        sub,
+        hf_config=hf_config,
+        stop_only=lookahead > 0 or (doc_reuse_id is not None and bi > 0),
+    )
+    if doc_reuse_id is not None:
+        # Keep this window's last page so the next one can splice its KV tail
+        # instead of recomputing it.
+        sub.custom_params.update(
+            {
+                uocr_doc_reuse.KEY_DOC_ID: doc_reuse_id,
+                uocr_doc_reuse.KEY_KEEP: bi < len(plan) - 1,
+                uocr_doc_reuse.KEY_REUSE: bi > 0,
+                uocr_doc_reuse.KEY_OVERLAP: emit_from - lo,
+            }
+        )
+    sub.rid = f"{doc_reuse_id or 'uocr-doc'}-w{bi}-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
+    if after is not None:
+        sub.custom_params.update(
+            {
+                uocr_doc_prefetch.KEY_AFTER: after,
+                uocr_doc_prefetch.KEY_BUDGET: remaining,
+            }
+        )
+    return sub
+
+
+def _apply_page_cap(sub, *, hf_config, stop_only: bool = False) -> None:
+    """Turn on the per-page length cap for one window, per --uocr-max-page-tokens.
+
+    The cap is enforced by a ``CustomLogitProcessor``, so a request that
+    brings none gets the built-in one; a request may name a lower threshold
+    but not a higher one (see ``doc_split.page_guard_params``). The processor
+    searches only generated tokens for repeated n-grams.
+    """
+    from sglang.srt.sampling.custom_logit_processor import (
+        NGRAM_OUTPUT_ONLY_KEY,
+        UOCR_PAGE_GUARD_PROCESSOR,
+    )
+
+    if sub.custom_logit_processor:
+        sub.custom_params = {
+            **(sub.custom_params or {}),
+            NGRAM_OUTPUT_ONLY_KEY: True,
+        }
+    # Not every checkpoint config defines eos_token_id.
+    eos = getattr(hf_config, "eos_token_id", None)
+    if isinstance(eos, (list, tuple, set)):
+        # Several ids end a turn; the cap forces one, so take the lowest.
+        eos = min(eos, default=None)
+    server_cap = UocrDocumentConfig.from_args(get_mm()).uocr_max_page_tokens
+    custom_params = dict(sub.custom_params or {})
+    options = sub.doc_split_options
+    if options is not None and options.max_page_tokens is not None:
+        custom_params["max_page_tokens"] = options.max_page_tokens
+    cap = doc_split.effective_max_page_tokens(
+        server_max_page_tokens=server_cap, custom_params=custom_params
+    )
+    params = doc_split.page_guard_params(
+        max_page_tokens=cap,
+        page_token_id=hf_config.sparse_attention_config.get("page_token_id"),
+        eos_token_id=eos,
+        custom_params=None,
+        stop_only=stop_only,
+    )
+    if not params:
+        return
+    if not sub.custom_logit_processor:
+        sub.custom_logit_processor = UOCR_PAGE_GUARD_PROCESSOR
+    params[NGRAM_OUTPUT_ONLY_KEY] = True
+    sub.custom_params = {**custom_params, **params}
+
+
+def _requested_max_tokens(request) -> Optional[int]:
+    # Same precedence as ChatCompletionRequest.to_sampling_params.
+    return request.max_completion_tokens or request.max_tokens
+
+
+def _window_limit(*, remaining_tokens, context_capacity) -> tuple[int, str]:
+    """A window's ``max_tokens`` and which bound set it."""
+    max_tokens = min(remaining_tokens, context_capacity)
+    if remaining_tokens < context_capacity:
+        return max_tokens, "global_budget"
+    if context_capacity < remaining_tokens:
+        return max_tokens, "context_capacity"
+    return max_tokens, "tied"
+
+
+def _usage_error(usage, *, bi, max_tokens) -> Optional[str]:
+    if usage is None:
+        return f"doc-split batch {bi} returned no usage accounting"
+    prompt_tokens = usage.prompt_tokens
+    completion_tokens = usage.completion_tokens
+    if (
+        type(prompt_tokens) is not int
+        or prompt_tokens < 0
+        or type(completion_tokens) is not int
+        or completion_tokens < 0
+        or completion_tokens > max_tokens
+    ):
+        return f"doc-split batch {bi} returned invalid usage accounting"
+    return None
+
+
+def _context_error_batch(
+    *, bi, max_tokens, context_capacity, remaining_tokens, context_pages
+) -> dict:
+    """Metadata row of a window the server rejected for not fitting the context."""
+    return {
+        "index": bi,
+        "finish": "length",
+        "matched_stop": None,
+        "page_count": 0,
+        "incomplete": True,
+        "markers": 0,
+        "retractions": 0,
+        "extra_pages": 0,
+        "head": "",
+        "tail": "",
+        "max_tokens": max_tokens,
+        "context_capacity": context_capacity,
+        "limit_source": "context_capacity",
+        "remaining_before": remaining_tokens,
+        "remaining_after": remaining_tokens,
+        "context_pages": context_pages,
+        "prompt_tokens": 0,
+        "completion_tokens": 0,
+    }
+
+
+def _window_batch(
+    choice,
+    usage,
+    *,
+    bi,
+    lo,
+    hi,
+    emit_from,
+    max_tokens,
+    context_capacity,
+    limit_source,
+    remaining_before,
+    remaining_after,
+) -> tuple[str, dict]:
+    """Owned text of one finished window and its metadata row."""
+    # Only the scheduler knows whether the window reused its predecessor's KV.
+    reused = uocr_doc_reuse.window_reused(choice.meta_info)
+    pages = _window_pages(reused, lo=lo, hi=hi, emit_from=emit_from)
+    content = choice.message.content or ""
+    owned, observed, expected = doc_split.select_batch_output(text=content, **pages)
+    bodies = doc_split.owned_page_bodies(owned)
+    batch = {
+        "index": bi,
+        "finish": choice.finish_reason,
+        "matched_stop": choice.matched_stop,
+        "page_count": observed,
+        "context_pages": pages["context_pages"],
+        "reused": reused,
+        # Blank and image-only pages legitimately yield empty bodies, so only
+        # the page count decides completeness; empties are reported separately.
+        "incomplete": doc_split.window_incomplete(observed, expected),
+        "empty_pages": [
+            emit_from + i for i, body in enumerate(bodies) if not body.strip()
+        ],
+        # Markers tell a window that wrote an extra page apart from one whose
+        # last body is empty; both inflate page_count.
+        "markers": content.count(doc_split.PAGE_MARKER),
+        "retractions": (choice.meta_info or {}).get("num_retractions", 0),
+        "extra_pages": max(0, observed - expected),
+        # A leading surplus marker means the spliced one leaked through the
+        # detokenizer, a trailing one that the model opened a page too many.
+        "head": content[:40],
+        "tail": content[-40:],
+        "max_tokens": max_tokens,
+        "context_capacity": context_capacity,
+        "limit_source": limit_source,
+        "remaining_before": remaining_before,
+        "remaining_after": remaining_after,
+        "prompt_tokens": usage.prompt_tokens,
+        "completion_tokens": usage.completion_tokens,
+        "prompt_tokens_details": usage.prompt_tokens_details,
+        "reasoning_tokens": usage.reasoning_tokens or 0,
+    }
+    return owned, batch
+
+
+def _merged_finish_reason(finishes, *, planned, incomplete) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Finish reason of the whole document, or None when every window stopped."""
+    terminal = next((f for f in finishes if f in ("abort", "content_filter")), None)
+    if terminal is not None:
+        return terminal
+    if any(f != "stop" for f in finishes) or len(finishes) < planned or incomplete:
+        return "length"
+    return None
+
+
+def _merged_usage(batches) -> UsageInfo:
+    """Token usage summed over every window that ran."""
+    detail_rows = [
+        batch["prompt_tokens_details"]
+        for batch in batches
+        if batch.get("prompt_tokens_details") is not None
+    ]
+    prompt_details = (
+        PromptTokensDetails(
+            cached_tokens=sum(row.cached_tokens for row in detail_rows),
+            image_tokens=sum(row.image_tokens or 0 for row in detail_rows) or None,
+            audio_tokens=sum(row.audio_tokens or 0 for row in detail_rows) or None,
+            video_tokens=sum(row.video_tokens or 0 for row in detail_rows) or None,
+        )
+        if detail_rows
+        else None
+    )
+    return UsageInfo(
+        prompt_tokens=sum(batch["prompt_tokens"] for batch in batches),
+        completion_tokens=sum(batch["completion_tokens"] for batch in batches),
+        total_tokens=sum(
+            batch["prompt_tokens"] + batch["completion_tokens"] for batch in batches
+        ),
+        prompt_tokens_details=prompt_details,
+        reasoning_tokens=sum(batch.get("reasoning_tokens", 0) for batch in batches),
+    )
+
+
+def _split_metadata(*, plan, batches, original_max_tokens, remaining_tokens) -> dict:
+    """What the split actually did. `batches` holds one dict per batch that ran."""
+    incomplete = [batch["index"] for batch in batches if batch["incomplete"]]
+    unstarted = list(range(len(batches), len(plan)))
+    mark = {
+        "doc_split_implementation": doc_split.SPLIT_VERSION,
+        "doc_split_budget_policy": doc_split.BUDGET_POLICY,
+        # Reuse is attempted per window and can fall back to recomputation,
+        # so doc_split_reused_batches below is what actually happened.
+        "doc_split_kv_reuse_mode": "copy-splice",
+        "doc_split_batches": len(batches),
+        "doc_split_planned_batches": len(plan),
+        "doc_split_incomplete_batches": incomplete,
+        # Global page indices whose owned body is empty; diagnostic only.
+        "doc_split_empty_pages": [
+            page for batch in batches for page in batch.get("empty_pages", ())
+        ],
+        "doc_split_reused_batches": [
+            batch["index"] for batch in batches if batch.get("reused")
+        ],
+        "doc_split_batch_finish_reasons": [batch["finish"] for batch in batches],
+        "doc_split_batch_matched_stops": [batch["matched_stop"] for batch in batches],
+        "doc_split_complete": (
+            len(batches) == len(plan)
+            and not incomplete
+            and all(batch["finish"] == "stop" for batch in batches)
+        ),
+        "doc_split_overlap_pages": (
+            next(
+                (
+                    batch.get("context_pages", 0)
+                    for batch in batches
+                    if batch.get("context_pages", 0) > 0
+                ),
+                0,
+            )
+            if len(plan) > 1
+            else 0
+        ),
+        "doc_split_batch_page_counts": [batch["page_count"] for batch in batches],
+        # A window with more bodies than pages is either one extra marker
+        # or one empty trailing body; these two tell them apart.
+        "doc_split_batch_marker_counts": [batch["markers"] for batch in batches],
+        "doc_split_batch_retractions": [batch["retractions"] for batch in batches],
+        # Bodies past the window's own pages; dropped, not a failure.
+        "doc_split_batch_extra_pages": [batch["extra_pages"] for batch in batches],
+        "doc_split_batch_heads": [batch["head"] for batch in batches],
+        "doc_split_batch_tails": [batch["tail"] for batch in batches],
+        "doc_split_original_max_completion_tokens": original_max_tokens,
+        "doc_split_batch_max_tokens": [batch["max_tokens"] for batch in batches],
+        "doc_split_batch_context_capacities": [
+            batch["context_capacity"] for batch in batches
+        ],
+        "doc_split_batch_completion_tokens": [
+            batch["completion_tokens"] for batch in batches
+        ],
+        "doc_split_batch_remaining_tokens_before": [
+            batch["remaining_before"] for batch in batches
+        ],
+        "doc_split_batch_remaining_tokens_after": [
+            batch["remaining_after"] for batch in batches
+        ],
+        "doc_split_batch_limit_sources": [batch["limit_source"] for batch in batches],
+        "doc_split_batch_truncation_sources": [
+            batch["limit_source"] if batch["finish"] == "length" else None
+            for batch in batches
+        ],
+        "doc_split_remaining_completion_tokens": remaining_tokens,
+        "doc_split_budget_exhausted": bool(unstarted and remaining_tokens == 0),
+        "doc_split_unstarted_batches": unstarted,
+        "doc_split_global_position_inherited": False,
+        "doc_split_sampling_state_inherited": False,
+    }
+    truncated = [batch["index"] for batch in batches if batch["finish"] == "length"]
+    if truncated:
+        mark["doc_split_truncated_batches"] = truncated
+    return mark
+
+
+def _assemble_split_response(
+    response, *, request, plan, texts, batches, original_max_tokens, remaining_tokens
+):
+    """Rewrite the last window's response into the whole document's answer."""
+    mark = _split_metadata(
+        plan=plan,
+        batches=batches,
+        original_max_tokens=original_max_tokens,
+        remaining_tokens=remaining_tokens,
+    )
+    choice = response.choices[0]
+    choice.message.content = "".join(texts)
+    if not request.return_meta_info:
+        # The windows were forced to return it; the parent did not ask.
+        choice.meta_info = None
+    finish = _merged_finish_reason(
+        [batch["finish"] for batch in batches],
+        planned=len(plan),
+        incomplete=any(batch["incomplete"] for batch in batches),
+    )
+    if finish is not None:
+        choice.finish_reason = finish
+        choice.matched_stop = None
+    response.usage = _merged_usage(batches)
+    inherited = dict(response.metadata or {})
+    inherited.pop("weight_versions", None)
+    inherited.pop("weight_version", None)
+    response.metadata = {**inherited, **mark}
+    logger.info(
+        "doc-split: %d pages -> %d/%d batches, %d chars, complete=%s, remaining=%d",
+        doc_split.count_images(request.messages),
+        len(batches),
+        len(plan),
+        len(choice.message.content),
+        mark["doc_split_complete"],
+        remaining_tokens,
+    )
+    return response
+
+
+class _SplitProgress(msgspec.Struct):
+    """What the windows of a non-streamed split document produced so far."""
+
+    remaining_tokens: int
+    texts: list = []
+    batches: list = []
+    last_response: Optional[object] = None
+    # A window finished with abort or content_filter; no later window runs.
+    terminal: bool = False
+
+    def add_window(self, response, *, owned: str, batch: dict) -> None:
+        """Keep a finished window's owned text and metadata row."""
+        self.last_response = response
+        self.remaining_tokens = batch["remaining_after"]
+        self.texts.append(owned)
+        self.batches.append(batch)
+        self.terminal = batch["finish"] in ("abort", "content_filter")
+
+
+class _StreamTotals(msgspec.Struct):
+    """Running accounting of a streamed split document."""
+
+    remaining: int
+    prompt: int = 0
+    completion: int = 0
+    cached: int = 0
+    image: int = 0
+    finishes: list = []
+    incomplete: bool = False
+    matched_stop: Optional[object] = None
+    # The role chunk went out; an error after it is an SSE payload, not HTTP.
+    started: bool = False
+
+    def lose_window(self) -> None:
+        """Account a window rejected for its context length."""
+        self.finishes.append("length")
+        self.incomplete = True
+
+
+def _account_stream_window(
+    window, totals, *, bi, lo, hi, emit_from, prompt_tokens
+) -> tuple[str, Optional[str]]:
+    """Fold a finished streamed window into ``totals``.
+
+    Returns the owned text not streamed yet and the window's finish type.
+    """
+    meta = window.meta
+    completion = meta.get("completion_tokens", 0)
+    totals.remaining -= completion
+    totals.prompt += prompt_tokens
+    totals.completion += completion
+    totals.cached += meta.get("cached_tokens", 0)
+    totals.image += meta.get("image_tokens", 0) or 0
+    owned, observed, expected = doc_split.select_batch_output(
+        text=window.text,
+        **_window_pages(window.reused, lo=lo, hi=hi, emit_from=emit_from),
+    )
+    tail = ""
+    if owned.startswith(window.sent):
+        tail = owned[len(window.sent) :]
+    else:
+        # Only a stray leading marker reorders ownership at the end;
+        # streamed text cannot be taken back.
+        logger.warning("doc-split stream: window %d ownership moved", bi)
+    totals.incomplete = totals.incomplete or doc_split.window_incomplete(
+        observed, expected
+    )
+    finish = meta.get("finish_reason") or {}
+    totals.finishes.append(finish.get("type"))
+    totals.matched_stop = finish.get("matched")
+    return tail, finish.get("type")
+
+
+class _SseFormatter(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):
+    """Formats the chunks of one SSE response; every chunk shares id and model."""
+
+    chunk_id: str
+    created: int
+    model: Optional[str]
+
+    def __call__(self, **kwargs) -> str:
+        return build_sse_content(
+            chunk_id=self.chunk_id,
+            created=self.created,
+            model=self.model,
+            index=0,
+            **kwargs,
+        )
+
+
+def _stream_epilogue(*, request, plan, totals, sse, include_usage):
+    """The finish chunk and the optional usage chunk that close a split stream."""
+    final_finish = (
+        _merged_finish_reason(
+            totals.finishes, planned=len(plan), incomplete=totals.incomplete
+        )
+        or "stop"
+    )
+    yield sse(
+        finish_reason=final_finish,
+        matched_stop=totals.matched_stop if final_finish == "stop" else None,
+    )
+    if include_usage:
+        usage = UsageProcessor.calculate_token_usage(
+            prompt_tokens=totals.prompt,
+            completion_tokens=totals.completion,
+            cached_tokens=(
+                UsageProcessor._details_if_cached(totals.cached)
+                if get_serving().enable_cache_report
+                else None
+            ),
+            image_tokens=totals.image,
+        )
+        usage_chunk = ChatCompletionStreamResponse(
+            id=sse.chunk_id,
+            created=sse.created,
+            choices=[],
+            model=request.model,
+            usage=usage,
+        )
+        yield f"data: {usage_chunk.model_dump_json()}\n\n"
+    logger.info(
+        "doc-split stream: %d pages -> %d/%d batches, finish=%s, remaining=%d",
+        doc_split.count_images(request.messages),
+        len(totals.finishes),
+        len(plan),
+        final_finish,
+        totals.remaining,
+    )
+
+
+class ChatDocSplitter:
+    """Chat-completions handling of Unlimited-OCR v2 multi-page documents.
+
+    Reads the owning ``OpenAIServingChat`` but never writes to it; each window
+    is served by ``handle_window``, the base class's ``handle_request``.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        serving: OpenAIServingChat,
+        *,
+        handle_window: Callable,
+        config: UocrDocumentConfig,
+    ):
+        self._serving = serving
+        self._tokenizer_manager = serving.tokenizer_manager
+        self._hf_config = serving.tokenizer_manager.model_config.hf_config
+        self._handle_window = handle_window
+        self._config = config
+
+    @classmethod
+    def for_model(
+        cls, serving: OpenAIServingChat, *, handle_window: Callable
+    ) -> Optional[ChatDocSplitter]:
+        """A splitter when ``serving`` runs Unlimited-OCR v2, else None."""
+        architectures = serving.tokenizer_manager.model_config.hf_config.architectures
+        if not architectures or architectures[0] != UNLIMITED_OCR_V2_ARCH:
+            return None
+        return cls(
+            serving,
+            handle_window=handle_window,
+            config=UocrDocumentConfig.from_args(get_mm()),
+        )
+
+    async def handle_request(self, request, raw_request):
+        """Serve a chat request, splitting a long document into page windows.
+
+        A multi-window answer is not lossless and says so in its response metadata.
+        """
+        if request.n != 1:
+            return await self._handle_window(request, raw_request)
+        options = request.doc_split_options
+        if (
+            not self._config.uocr_doc_split
+            and options is not None
+            and any(
+                value is not None
+                for value in (
+                    options.max_batch_pages,
+                    options.overlap_pages,
+                    options.lookahead_pages,
+                )
+            )
+        ):
+            return self._serving.create_error_response(
+                "window options in doc_split_options require --uocr-doc-split"
+            )
+        try:
+            plan = self._plan_doc_split(request)
+        except ValueError as e:
+            return self._serving.create_error_response(str(e))
+        except Exception:
+            # A planning bug must not take the request down; the base path still
+            # answers (or rejects with its accurate message).
+            logger.exception("doc-split planning failed; serving the request as-is")
+            plan = None
+        if plan is None:
+            # The page guard applies to an unsplit document too; the shallow
+            # copy keeps the caller's request unchanged.
+            if doc_split.count_images(request.messages):
+                request = request.model_copy(deep=False)
+                _apply_page_cap(request, hf_config=self._hf_config)
+            return await self._handle_window(request, raw_request)
+        # Every multi-window document reuses the previous window's KV.
+        doc_reuse_id = f"uocr-doc-{uuid.uuid4().hex}" if len(plan) > 1 else None
+        if request.stream:
+            # The stream outlives this call, so it releases the document itself.
+            return await self._handle_split_document_stream(
+                request, raw_request, plan, doc_reuse_id=doc_reuse_id
+            )
+        try:
+            return await self._handle_split_document(
+                request, raw_request, plan, doc_reuse_id=doc_reuse_id
+            )
+        finally:
+            # A disconnect, an abort or an early stop leaves the last finished
+            # window retained with no follow-up to consume it.
+            if doc_reuse_id is not None:
+                self._tokenizer_manager.release_uocr_doc(doc_reuse_id)
+
+    def _plan_doc_split(self, request) -> Optional[list[tuple[int, int, int]]]:
+        """``[(lo, hi, emit_from), ...]`` or None. Cheap: no tokenization."""
+        if not self._config.uocr_doc_split:
+            return None
+        limit = self._tokenizer_manager.max_req_input_len
+        if not limit:
+            return None
+        if not self._is_splittable(request):
+            return None
+        max_tokens = _requested_max_tokens(request)
+        if max_tokens is None or max_tokens <= 0 or request.min_tokens > 0:
+            return None
+        image_mode = _doc_image_mode(request)

+"""Pinned host staging and asynchronous crop transfer for Unlimited OCR."""
+
+import contextlib
+import logging
+import weakref
+from concurrent.futures import Future, ThreadPoolExecutor
+from typing import Optional
+
+import msgspec
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.utils.nvtx_utils import operations_nvtx_range
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+# Background threads staging crops into pinned host memory.
+_PREFETCH_WORKERS = 4
+# Prepared crops held at once, alongside the SGLANG_UOCR_CROP_PREFETCH_MAX_MB cap.
+_PREFETCH_MAX_ITEMS = 128
+# Event-protected pinned buffers per crop batch shape for synchronous staging.
+_PIN_SLOTS = 1
+
+
+class CropTransferConfig(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):
+    """Store resolved crop-transfer switches and resource limits."""
+
+    enabled: bool
+    max_bytes: int
+
+
+class CropSignature(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):
+    """Describe the identity and mutation state of a crop tensor."""
+
+    shape: tuple[int, ...]
+    stride: tuple[int, ...]
+    dtype: object
+    data_ptr: int
+    version: Optional[int]
+
+
+class CropEntry(msgspec.Struct):
+    """Track one prepared crop and its active transfers."""
+
+    source_ref: object
+    signature: CropSignature
+    size: int
+    future: Future
+    leases: int = 0
+    invalidated: bool = False
+    released: bool = False
+
+
+class RetiredTransfer(msgspec.Struct):
+    """Hold crop buffers until their CUDA transfer completes."""
+
+    event: object
+    buffers: list[torch.Tensor]
+    entries: list[CropEntry]
+
+
+class PinnedSlot(msgspec.Struct):
+    """Store a reusable pinned buffer and its completion event."""
+
+    buffer: torch.Tensor
+    event: object = None
+
+
+def _read_config() -> CropTransferConfig:
+    megabytes = envs.SGLANG_UOCR_CROP_PREFETCH_MAX_MB.get()
+    if not 1 <= megabytes <= 16384:
+        raise ValueError("SGLANG_UOCR_CROP_PREFETCH_MAX_MB must be between 1 and 16384")
+    return CropTransferConfig(
+        enabled=envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_UOCR_CROP_PREFETCH.get(),
+        max_bytes=megabytes * 1024 * 1024,
+    )
+
+
+def _signature(source: torch.Tensor) -> CropSignature:
+    try:
+        version = source._version
+    except RuntimeError:
+        version = None
+    return CropSignature(
+        shape=tuple(source.shape),
+        stride=tuple(source.stride()),
+        dtype=source.dtype,
+        data_ptr=source.data_ptr(),
+        version=version,
+    )
+
+
+def _stage(
+    source: torch.Tensor,
+    dtype: torch.dtype,
+    inference_mode: bool,
+    grad_enabled: bool,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    with torch.inference_mode(inference_mode), torch.set_grad_enabled(grad_enabled):
+        with operations_nvtx_range("ocr.crop_prefetch_allocate"):
+            try:
+                result = torch.empty(
+                    source.shape, dtype=dtype, device="cpu", pin_memory=True
+                )
+            except RuntimeError:
+                with operations_nvtx_range("ocr.crop_prefetch_pageable"):
+                    result = torch.empty(source.shape, dtype=dtype, device="cpu")
+        with operations_nvtx_range("ocr.crop_prefetch_cpu_copy"):
+            result.copy_(source)
+    return result
+

+def iter_crop_sources(requests) -> list[torch.Tensor]:
+    """Collect eligible crop tensors from tokenized requests in order."""
+    from sglang.srt.managers.io_struct import (
+        BaseBatchReq,
+        TokenizedEmbeddingReqInput,
+        TokenizedGenerateReqInput,
+    )
+    from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import (
+        MultimodalInputs,
+        MultimodalProcessorOutput,
+    )

+    sources = []
+    for request in requests:
+        values = request.batch if isinstance(request, BaseBatchReq) else (request,)
+        for value in values:
+            if not isinstance(
+                value, (TokenizedGenerateReqInput, TokenizedEmbeddingReqInput)
+            ):
+                continue
+            mm_inputs = value.mm_inputs
+            if not isinstance(mm_inputs, (MultimodalProcessorOutput, MultimodalInputs)):
+                continue

+class UnlimitedOcrCropTransfer:
+    """Prepare Unlimited-OCR crops and transfer them to the model device."""

+    def __init__(self, *, model_dtype: Optional[torch.dtype] = None):

+            and source.layout == torch.strided
+            and source.numel() > 0
+            and all(stride != 0 for stride in source.stride())
+        )

+            return False
+        size = source.numel() * torch.empty((), dtype=dtype).element_size()

+            self.reserved_bytes + size > self.config.max_bytes
+            or self.reserved_items >= _PREFETCH_MAX_ITEMS
+        ):
+            with operations_nvtx_range("ocr.crop_prefetch_budget_skip"):
+                pass
+            return False
+        future = self.executor.submit(
+            _stage,
+            source,
+            dtype,
+            torch.is_inference_mode_enabled(),
+            torch.is_grad_enabled(),
+        )

+            source_ref=weakref.ref(source),
+            signature=_signature(source),
+            size=size,
+            future=future,
+        )
+        self.reserved_bytes += size
+        self.reserved_items += 1

+
+    def prefetch_items(self, items: list[object], dtype: torch.dtype) -> None:
+        """Prepare crops from multimodal items before model execution."""
+        self.prefetch_sources(
+            sources=[item.model_specific_data.get("images_crop") for item in items],
+            dtype=dtype,
+        )
+
+    def prefetch_requests(self, requests) -> None:
+        """Prepare crops from scheduler-published requests."""
+        if self.model_dtype is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("crop prefetch model dtype is not initialized")

+            sources=iter_crop_sources(requests),
+            dtype=self.model_dtype,

+    def prefetch_sources(self, sources, dtype: torch.dtype) -> None:
+        """Submit all eligible crop tensors from an input sequence."""
+        if not self.config.enabled or self.closed:
+            return

+        if not eligible:
+            return

+            for source in eligible:

+    def _release(self, entries: list[CropEntry]) -> None:
+        fresh = [entry for entry in entries if not entry.released]
+        self.reserved_bytes -= sum(entry.size for entry in fresh)
+        self.reserved_items -= len(fresh)
+        for entry in fresh:

+    def _invalid(self, entry: CropEntry) -> bool:

+        return (
+            entry.source_ref() is None
+            or entry.future.cancelled()

+        )
+
+    def _retire_if_unused(self, key: tuple[int, torch.dtype], entry: CropEntry) -> None:
+        if entry.leases or not entry.future.done() or not self._invalid(entry):
+            return
+        if self.entries.get(key) is entry:
+            del self.entries[key]
+        self._release([entry])
+
+    def reap(self) -> None:
+        """Release invalid entries and completed transfer leases."""
+        for key, entry in list(self.entries.items()):
+            if entry.future.done() and self._invalid(entry):
+                if (
+                    not entry.future.cancelled()
+                    and entry.future.exception() is not None
+                ):
+                    logger.warning(
+                        "Dropping failed crop prefetch: %s", entry.future.exception()
+                    )
+                entry.invalidated = True
+                self._retire_if_unused(key, entry)
+        remaining = []
+        completed = []
+        for retired in self.retired:
+            if retired.event is None or retired.event.query():
+                completed.extend(retired.entries)
+            else:
+                remaining.append(retired)
+        self.retired = remaining
+        for entry in completed:
+            if not entry.leases:
+                raise RuntimeError("crop prefetch lease accounting underflow")
+            entry.leases -= 1
+        for key, entry in list(self.entries.items()):
+            self._retire_if_unused(key, entry)
+        for entry in completed:
+            if entry.invalidated and not entry.leases:
+                self._release([entry])
+
+    def _copy_stream(self, device: torch.device):
+        key = str(device)
+        stream = self.copy_streams.get(key)
+        if stream is None:
+            stream = torch.cuda.Stream(device=device)
+            self.copy_streams[key] = stream
+        return stream
+
+    def _take_entries(
+        self, keys: list[tuple[int, torch.dtype]]
+    ) -> dict[tuple[int, torch.dtype], CropEntry]:
+        unique_keys = dict.fromkeys(keys)
+        return {key: self.entries[key] for key in unique_keys if key in self.entries}
+
+    def _resolve_prepared(
+        self,
+        key: tuple[int, torch.dtype],
+        source: torch.Tensor,
+        entry: Optional[CropEntry],
+        dtype: torch.dtype,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        prepared = None
+        if entry is not None:
+            span = (
+                "ocr.crop_prefetch_ready"
+                if entry.future.done()
+                else "ocr.crop_prefetch_wait"
+            )
+            with operations_nvtx_range(span):
+                try:
+                    candidate = entry.future.result()
+                except Exception:
+                    logger.warning(
+                        "Crop prefetch failed; using native conversion", exc_info=True
+                    )
+                else:
+                    if entry.source_ref() is source and entry.signature == _signature(
+                        source
+                    ):
+                        prepared = candidate
+                    else:
+                        entry.invalidated = True
+        if prepared is None:
+            with operations_nvtx_range("ocr.crop_prefetch_fallback_stage"):
+                prepared = _stage(
+                    source,
+                    dtype,
+                    torch.is_inference_mode_enabled(),
+                    torch.is_grad_enabled(),
+                )
+        return prepared
+
+    def _finalize_taken(
+        self,
+        taken: dict[tuple[int, torch.dtype], CropEntry],
+        event: object,
+        buffers: list[torch.Tensor],
+    ) -> None:
+        finished = []
+        for key, entry in taken.items():
+            if not entry.future.done():
+                self.entries[key] = entry
+                continue
+            if not entry.invalidated:
+                entry.leases += 1
+                finished.append(entry)
+                continue
+            entry.invalidated = True
+            if self.entries.get(key) is entry:
+                del self.entries[key]
+            if event is None:
+                self._release([entry])
+            else:
+                entry.leases += 1
+                finished.append(entry)
+        if finished:
+            self.retired.append(
+                RetiredTransfer(event=event, buffers=buffers, entries=finished)
+            )
+
+    def try_stack_prefetched(
+        self,
+        tensors: list[torch.Tensor],
+        dtype: torch.dtype,
+        device: torch.device,
+    ) -> Optional[torch.Tensor]:
+        """Stack prepared crops on the target device when cache entries exist."""
+        if self.quarantined:
+            raise RuntimeError("Crop prefetch disabled after CUDA stream failure")
+        if self.closed or not self.config.enabled or not tensors:
+            return None
+        first_shape = tuple(tensors[0].shape)
+        if any(
+            not self._eligible(tensor) or tuple(tensor.shape) != first_shape
+            for tensor in tensors
+        ):
+            return None
+        keys = [(id(tensor), dtype) for tensor in tensors]
+        if not any(key in self.entries for key in keys):
+            with operations_nvtx_range("ocr.crop_prefetch_batch_miss"):
+                pass
+            return None
+        self.reap()
+        taken = self._take_entries(keys)
+        buffers = []
+        prepared_by_key = {}
+        event = None
+        stream = None
+        consumer_stream = None
+        try:
+            target = torch.device(device)
+            # CUDA copies run on a side stream the consumer stream waits on.
+            use_copy_stream = target.type == "cuda"
+            if use_copy_stream:
+                consumer_stream = torch.cuda.current_stream(target)
+                stream = self._copy_stream(target)
+                event = torch.cuda.Event()
+            result = torch.empty(
+                (len(tensors), *first_shape), dtype=dtype, device=target
+            )
+            if use_copy_stream:
+                stream.wait_stream(consumer_stream)
+            context = (
+                torch.cuda.stream(stream)
+                if use_copy_stream
+                else contextlib.nullcontext()
+            )
+            with context:
+                with operations_nvtx_range("ocr.crop_prefetch_h2d_enqueue"):
+                    for index, (key, source) in enumerate(zip(keys, tensors)):
+                        prepared = prepared_by_key.get(key)
+                        if prepared is None:
+                            prepared = self._resolve_prepared(
+                                key, source, taken.get(key), dtype
+                            )
+                        buffers.append(prepared)
+                        prepared_by_key[key] = prepared
+                        result[index].copy_(prepared, non_blocking=True)
+                if event is not None:
+                    event.record(stream)
+            if use_copy_stream:
+                with operations_nvtx_range("ocr.crop_prefetch_copy_stream_wait"):
+                    consumer_stream.wait_event(event)
+                result.record_stream(stream)
+            return result
+        finally:
+            # An event exists only for a CUDA target, which uses the copy stream.
+            if event is not None:
+                try:
+                    event.query()
+                except Exception:
+                    try:
+                        stream.synchronize()
+                    except Exception:
+                        quarantined = list(taken.values())
+                        for entry in quarantined:
+                            if not entry.released:
+                                entry.leases += 1
+                        self.quarantined.append((stream, buffers, quarantined))
+                        raise
+                    event = None
+            self._finalize_taken(taken, event, buffers)
+
+    def _native_stack(
+        self,
+        tensors: list[torch.Tensor],
+        dtype: torch.dtype,
+        device: torch.device,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        first = tensors[0]
+        target = torch.device(device)
+        if first.device == target:
+            return torch.stack(tensors, dim=0).type(dtype)
+        count = len(tensors)
+        shape = (count, *first.shape)
+        key = (shape, dtype, str(target))
+        slots = self.pinned_slots.get(key)
+        if slots is None:
+            try:
+                slots = [
+                    PinnedSlot(torch.empty(shape, dtype=dtype, pin_memory=True))
+                    for _ in range(_PIN_SLOTS)
+                ]
+            except RuntimeError:
+                return torch.stack(tensors, dim=0).type(dtype).to(device=target)
+            self.pinned_slots[key] = slots
+        cursor = self.pin_cursors.get(key, 0) % len(slots)
+        self.pin_cursors[key] = cursor + 1
+        slot = slots[cursor]
+        if slot.event is not None:
+            try:
+                ready = slot.event.query()
+            except Exception:
+                self.quarantined.append((None, [slot.buffer], []))
+                raise
+            if not ready:
+                with operations_nvtx_range("ocr.crop_pin_wait"):
+                    slot.event.synchronize()
+        buffer = slot.buffer[:count]
+        with operations_nvtx_range("ocr.crop_cpu_stage"):
+            for index, tensor in enumerate(tensors):
+                buffer[index].copy_(tensor)
+        if target.type != "cuda":
+            with operations_nvtx_range("ocr.crop_h2d_enqueue"):
+                return buffer.to(device=target, non_blocking=True)
+        stream = torch.cuda.current_stream(target)
+        event = torch.cuda.Event()
+        slot.event = event
+        result = None
+        try:
+            with operations_nvtx_range("ocr.crop_h2d_enqueue"):
+                result = buffer.to(device=target, non_blocking=True)
+            event.record(stream)
+            return result
+        except Exception:
+            try:
+                stream.synchronize()
+            except Exception:
+                retained = [slot.buffer]
+                if result is not None:
+                    retained.append(result)
+                self.quarantined.append((stream, retained, []))
+                raise
+            slot.event = None
+            raise
+
+    def stack(
+        self,
+        tensors: list[torch.Tensor],
+        dtype: torch.dtype,
+        device: torch.device,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Stack crops on the target device using prefetch when available."""
+        if not tensors:
+            raise ValueError("crop transfer requires at least one tensor")
+        with operations_nvtx_range("ocr.crop_prefetch_consume"):
+            prefetched = self.try_stack_prefetched(tensors, dtype, device)
+        if prefetched is not None:
+            return prefetched
+        return self._native_stack(tensors, dtype, device)
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        """Stop workers and wait for all crop transfers to release storage."""
+        if self.closed:
+            return
+        self.closed = True
+        if self.executor is not None:
+            self.executor.shutdown(wait=True, cancel_futures=True)
+        for retired in self.retired:
+            if retired.event is not None:
+                retired.event.synchronize()
+            for entry in retired.entries:
+                entry.leases = max(0, entry.leases - 1)
+        for stream, _, entries in self.quarantined:
+            if stream is not None:
+                stream.synchronize()
+            for entry in entries:
+                entry.leases = max(0, entry.leases - 1)
+        for slots in self.pinned_slots.values():
+            for slot in slots:
+                if slot.event is not None:
+                    slot.event.synchronize()
+        self.entries.clear()
+        self.retired.clear()
+        self.quarantined.clear()
+        self.copy_streams.clear()
+        self.pinned_slots.clear()
+        self.reserved_bytes = 0
+        self.reserved_items = 0
+
+    def __del__(self):
+        self.close()

+"""Relay Unlimited-OCR decode inputs and outputs through CUDA graphs."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Optional
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.clamp_position import clamp_position
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import ScheduleBatch
+    from sglang.srt.managers.utils import GenerationBatchResult
+    from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardBatch
+    from sglang.srt.models.unlimited_ocr_v2_support.greedy_graph import UocrGreedyGraph
+
+
+class UOCRDecodeGraphIO:
+    """Manage fixed-address Unlimited-OCR decode graph inputs and outputs."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self, *, num_rows: int, device: torch.device | str, captured_ids: torch.Tensor
+    ):
+        # Next decode input per req_to_token row.
+        self.relay = torch.zeros(num_rows, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+        self._captured_ids = captured_ids
+
+    @classmethod
+    def maybe_create(
+        cls,
+        *,
+        attn_backend,
+        greedy_graph: Optional[UocrGreedyGraph],
+        num_rows: int,
+        device: torch.device | str,
+    ) -> Optional[UOCRDecodeGraphIO]:
+        """Create graph I/O state when the loaded model supports it."""
+        if greedy_graph is None:
+            return None
+        from sglang.srt.layers.attention.unlimited_ocr_v2_backend import (
+            UnlimitedOCRV2AttnBackend,
+        )
+
+        if not isinstance(attn_backend, UnlimitedOCRV2AttnBackend):
+            return None
+        return cls(num_rows=num_rows, device=device, captured_ids=greedy_graph.ids)
+
+    def can_defer(self, batch: ScheduleBatch) -> bool:
+        """Return whether the CUDA graph can produce this batch's decode inputs."""
+        sampling = batch.sampling_info
+        penalizer = sampling.penalizer_orchestrator
+        return bool(
+            batch.enable_overlap
+            and batch.forward_mode.is_decode()
+            and batch.spec_algorithm.is_none()
+            and batch.input_ids is None
+            and batch.beam_tail is None
+            and batch.return_logprob is False
+            and sampling.is_all_greedy
+            and sampling.logit_bias is None
+            and sampling.grammar_mask is None
+            and not sampling.has_custom_logit_processor
+            and not sampling.has_watermark_candidates
+            and (penalizer is None or not penalizer.is_required)
+        )
+
+    def seed(self, indices: torch.Tensor, tokens: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+        """Seed relay slots from an eager decode result."""
+        self.relay[indices] = tokens.to(self.relay.dtype)
+
+    def record_prologue(self, forward_batch: ForwardBatch) -> None:
+        """Record graph operations that load relayed decode inputs."""
+        forward_batch.input_ids.copy_(self.relay[forward_batch.req_pool_indices])
+        forward_batch.positions.copy_(clamp_position(forward_batch.seq_lens))
+
+    def record_tail(
+        self, runner, out, forward_batch: ForwardBatch, num_tokens: int
+    ) -> None:
+        """Record graph operations that publish sampled decode tokens."""
+        if out is None:
+            return
+        rows = int(out.next_token_logits.shape[0])
+        self.relay[forward_batch.req_pool_indices[:rows]] = self._captured_ids[:rows]
+
+    def materialize_eager(self, forward_batch: ForwardBatch) -> None:
+        """Load relayed inputs when the current decode runs eagerly."""
+        forward_batch.input_ids = self.relay[forward_batch.req_pool_indices]
+        forward_batch.positions = clamp_position(forward_batch.seq_lens)
+        forward_batch.uocr_graph_io_deferred = False
+
+    def graph_published(
+        self, batch: ScheduleBatch, result: GenerationBatchResult
+    ) -> bool:
+        """Return whether the graph already published the sampled tokens."""
+        return result.can_run_cuda_graph and self.can_defer(batch)
+
+    def relay_result(
+        self,
+        batch: ScheduleBatch,
+        result: GenerationBatchResult,
+        indices: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Seed the relay from a result the graph did not already publish."""
+        if result.has_sampled_token_ids and not self.graph_published(batch, result):
+            self.seed(indices, result.next_token_ids)
+
+
+def resolve_uocr_decode_graph_io(decode_runner: Any) -> Optional[UOCRDecodeGraphIO]:
+    """Graph I/O state of the current decode graph runner, if it relays."""
+    from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner.decode_cuda_graph_runner import (
+        DecodeCudaGraphRunner,
+    )
+
+    if isinstance(decode_runner, DecodeCudaGraphRunner):
+        return decode_runner.uocr_graph_io
+    return None
