+"""DASH bias-aware block-sparse attention (prefill, split-K decode + merge) must
+match the PyTorch reference: biased remote blocks plus an unbiased local window."""
+
+import sys
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.unlimited_ocr_dash.attend import (
+    dash_sparse_attn,
+    dash_sparse_attn_decode,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.kernels.unlimited_ocr_dash import sparse_attn_reference
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=120, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="1-gpu-large")
+
+NUM_PAGES, NUM_KV_HEADS, NUM_HEADS, HEAD_DIM, TOPK = 48, 2, 8, 128, 6
+
+
+def _cache(block_size: int, fp8: bool, gen: torch.Generator):
+    shape = (NUM_PAGES, block_size, NUM_KV_HEADS, HEAD_DIM)
+    k = torch.randn(shape, device="cuda", generator=gen).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    v = torch.randn(shape, device="cuda", generator=gen).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    if fp8:
+        k, v = k.to(torch.float8_e4m3fn), v.to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    return k, v
+
+
+def _select(query_pos, local_blocks, block_size, gen, pad_slots=0):
+    """Packed remote blocks per (kv head, row), never the query's own local window."""
+    rows = len(query_pos)
+    idx = torch.full((NUM_KV_HEADS, rows, TOPK + pad_slots), -1, dtype=torch.int32)
+    for t, pos in enumerate(query_pos):
+        # With no local window the query block itself must be selected.
+        n_remote = pos // block_size + (1 if local_blocks == 0 else 1 - local_blocks)
+        for g in range(NUM_KV_HEADS):
+            pool = torch.randperm(max(n_remote, 0), generator=gen)[:TOPK]
+            idx[g, t, : pool.numel()] = pool.to(torch.int32)
+    return idx.cuda()
+
+
+def _bias(idx, gen):
+    return torch.randn(idx.shape, generator=gen).cuda() * (idx >= 0)
+
+
+def _tolerance(fp8: bool):
+    return dict(atol=6e-2, rtol=6e-2) if fp8 else dict(atol=2e-2, rtol=2e-2)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("block_size", [64, 128])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("local_blocks", [0, 1, 2])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("with_bias", [True, False])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fp8", [False, True])
+def test_prefill_matches_reference(block_size, local_blocks, with_bias, fp8):
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1)
+    k, v = _cache(block_size, fp8, torch.Generator("cuda").manual_seed(1))
+    # Prefix lengths hit position 0, a block edge and a mid-block start.
+    prefix = [0, 2 * block_size - 1, 3 * block_size + 5]
+    q_lens = [3, 4, 2 * block_size + 1]
+    seq = [p + n for p, n in zip(prefix, q_lens)]
+    bt = torch.stack([torch.randperm(NUM_PAGES, generator=gen)[:12] for _ in seq])
+    query_pos = [p + j for p, n in zip(prefix, q_lens) for j in range(n)]
+    row_req = [r for r, n in enumerate(q_lens) for _ in range(n)]
+    idx = _select(query_pos, local_blocks, block_size, gen)
+    bias = _bias(idx, gen) if with_bias else None
+    q = torch.randn(len(query_pos), NUM_HEADS, HEAD_DIM, generator=gen)
+    q = q.to(torch.bfloat16).cuda()
+    cu = torch.tensor([0] + q_lens, dtype=torch.int32).cumsum(0).to(torch.int32)
+    out = torch.zeros_like(q)
+    dash_sparse_attn(
+        q,
+        k,
+        v,
+        idx,
+        bias,
+        bt.to(torch.int32).cuda(),
+        cu.cuda(),
+        torch.tensor(seq, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"),
+        torch.tensor(prefix, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"),
+        max(q_lens),
+        NUM_KV_HEADS,
+        HEAD_DIM**-0.5,
+        out,
+        local_blocks=local_blocks,
+        sparse_block_size=block_size,
+    )
+    ref = sparse_attn_reference(
+        q=q,
+        k_cache=k,
+        v_cache=v,
+        topk_idx=idx,
+        blk_bias=bias,
+        block_table=bt.cuda(),
+        query_pos=query_pos,
+        row_req=row_req,
+        local_blocks=local_blocks,
+        block_size=block_size,
+        sm_scale=HEAD_DIM**-0.5,
+    )
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out.float(), ref, **_tolerance(fp8))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("decode_query_len", [1, 2])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("local_blocks", [0, 1])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("chunk_width", [None, 1, 64])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fp8", [False, True])
+def test_decode_matches_reference(decode_query_len, local_blocks, chunk_width, fp8):
+    """chunk_width=1 forces a single split-K chunk; 64 forces more chunks than
+    selected blocks, so the merge must ignore empty (-inf) chunks."""
+    block_size = 128
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(2)
+    k, v = _cache(block_size, fp8, torch.Generator("cuda").manual_seed(2))
+    # seq 1: only the query itself; 256: block-aligned end; 1000: deep context.
+    seq = [1, 2 * block_size, 1000, block_size + 1]
+    seq = [max(s, decode_query_len) for s in seq]
+    bt = torch.stack([torch.randperm(NUM_PAGES, generator=gen)[:12] for _ in seq])
+    query_pos = [s - decode_query_len + j for s in seq for j in range(decode_query_len)]
+    row_req = [r for r in range(len(seq)) for _ in range(decode_query_len)]
+    # Trailing -1 slots keep the stable buffer wider than any row's selection.
+    idx = _select(query_pos, local_blocks, block_size, gen, pad_slots=2)
+    bias = _bias(idx, gen)
+    q = torch.randn(len(query_pos), NUM_HEADS, HEAD_DIM, generator=gen)
+    q = q.to(torch.bfloat16).cuda()
+    out = torch.full_like(q, float("nan"))
+    dash_sparse_attn_decode(
+        q,
+        k,
+        v,
+        idx,
+        bias,
+        bt.to(torch.int32).cuda(),
+        torch.tensor(seq, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"),
+        NUM_KV_HEADS,
+        HEAD_DIM**-0.5,
+        out,
+        decode_query_len,
+        local_blocks=local_blocks,
+        sparse_block_size=block_size,
+        chunk_width=chunk_width,
+    )
+    ref = sparse_attn_reference(
+        q=q,
+        k_cache=k,
+        v_cache=v,
+        topk_idx=idx,
+        blk_bias=bias,
+        block_table=bt.cuda(),
+        query_pos=query_pos,
+        row_req=row_req,
+        local_blocks=local_blocks,
+        block_size=block_size,
+        sm_scale=HEAD_DIM**-0.5,
+    )
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out.float(), ref, **_tolerance(fp8))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v", "-s"]))

+"""Fused one-token decode metadata (page ids, Page2D coordinates, candidate mask,
+local-window union, cos/sin table) and the Page2D RoPE kernels must match the
+PyTorch path the backend uses for every other step."""
+
+import copy
+import sys
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.unlimited_ocr_dash.decode_meta import (
+    local_union_fused,
+)
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.unlimited_ocr_dash.page2d_rope import (
+    apply_page2d_rope,
+    apply_page2d_rope_pair,
+)
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.unlimited_dash_ops.decode_meta import (
+    cos_sin_2d_fused,
+    decode_allow_fused,
+    decode_meta_fused,
+)
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.unlimited_dash_ops.page2d_rope import (
+    PageCoordState,
+    PageRope2D,
+)
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.unlimited_dash_ops.page_state import (
+    BatchLayout,
+    PageIsolationState,
+)
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.unlimited_ocr_v2_backend import (
+    UnlimitedOCRV2AttnBackend,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.kernels.unlimited_ocr_dash import (
+    cos_sin_2d_reference,
+    local_union_reference,
+    page2d_rope_reference,
+    torch_decode_page_meta,
+)
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=20, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="1-gpu-large")
+
+BS, IMG, PAGE, MM_PAD = 128, 99, 7, 1_000_000
+NUM_BLOCKS, WIDTH = 64, 12
+
+
+def _prompt(n_pages: int, images_per_page: int, with_marker: bool) -> list[int]:
+    ids = [1, 2, 3]
+    for p in range(n_pages):
+        ids += ([PAGE] if with_marker else []) + [MM_PAD + p] * images_per_page
+        ids += [4, 5]
+    return ids
+
+
+def _prefilled_state(prompts, with_marker: bool):
+    """Page / coordinate state after a PyTorch prefill of ``prompts``."""
+    cfg = {"image_token_id": IMG, "per_page_image_tokens": 50}
+    if with_marker:
+        cfg["page_token_id"] = PAGE
+    page_state = PageIsolationState(cfg, BS)
+    coord_state = PageCoordState(cfg, max_reqs=8, max_pages=16)
+    # Block 0 is reserved: never live, so stale table columns point at no image page.
+    bt = torch.zeros(len(prompts), WIDTH, dtype=torch.int32)
+    for r in range(len(prompts)):
+        bt[r] = 1 + r * WIDTH + torch.arange(WIDTH)
+    bt = bt.cuda()
+    lens = torch.tensor([len(p) for p in prompts], device="cuda")
+    q_start = torch.cat([torch.zeros(1, device="cuda"), lens.cumsum(0)]).long()
+    ids = torch.tensor(sum(prompts, []), device="cuda")
+    req = torch.arange(len(prompts), device="cuda").repeat_interleave(lens)
+    pos = torch.arange(ids.numel(), device="cuda") - q_start[req]
+    slots = bt.long()[req].gather(1, (pos // BS)[:, None]).squeeze(1) * BS + pos % BS
+    layout = BatchLayout(
+        num_tokens=ids.numel(),
+        num_reqs=len(prompts),
+        q_start=q_start,
+        start_pos=torch.zeros(len(prompts), dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda"),
+        block_table=bt,
+        req_of_token=req,
+    )
+    page_state.step(ids, layout, slots, NUM_BLOCKS * BS)
+    coord_state.step(ids, layout)
+    return page_state, coord_state, bt, lens.to(torch.int32)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("with_marker", [True, False])
+def test_fused_decode_meta_matches_torch_path(with_marker):
+    # Prompt ends land mid-block, exactly on a block edge, and one past it.
+    prompts = [_prompt(2, 60, with_marker), _prompt(3, 40, with_marker)]
+    prompts.append([1] * (2 * BS - 1))
+    prompts.append(_prompt(1, 121, with_marker))
+    fused_page, fused_coord, bt, seq = _prefilled_state(prompts, with_marker)
+    torch_page, torch_coord = copy.deepcopy(fused_page), copy.deepcopy(fused_coord)
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(int(with_marker))
+    num_slots = NUM_BLOCKS * BS
+    for _ in range(6):
+        seq = seq + 1
+        pos = seq.long() - 1
+        slots = bt.long().gather(1, (pos // BS)[:, None]).squeeze(1) * BS + pos % BS
+        choices = torch.tensor([PAGE, IMG, MM_PAD + 3, 4, 5])
+        ids = choices[torch.randint(0, 5, (seq.numel(),), generator=gen)].cuda()
+        q_page, coords = decode_meta_fused(
+            input_ids=ids,
+            block_table=bt,
+            seq_lens=seq,
+            slot_mapping=slots,
+            page_state=fused_page,
+            coord_state=fused_coord,
+            num_slots=num_slots,
+            block_size=BS,
+        )
+        allow = decode_allow_fused(
+            block_table=bt,
+            page_state=fused_page,
+            q_page=q_page,
+            seq_lens=seq,
+            max_block=WIDTH + 3,
+            num_blocks=NUM_BLOCKS,
+            block_size=BS,
+        )
+        ref_q_page, ref_allow, ref_coords = torch_decode_page_meta(
+            page_state=torch_page,
+            coord_state=torch_coord,
+            input_ids=ids,
+            block_table=bt,
+            seq_lens=seq,
+            slot_mapping=slots,
+            num_slots=num_slots,
+            max_block=WIDTH + 3,
+            num_blocks=NUM_BLOCKS,
+        )
+        assert torch.equal(q_page, ref_q_page)
+        assert torch.equal(coords[0], ref_coords[0])
+        assert torch.equal(coords[1], ref_coords[1])
+        assert torch.equal(allow.bool(), ref_allow)
+        for name in ("_slot_img_page", "_slot_marker_cum", "_slot_img_run"):
+            assert torch.equal(getattr(fused_page, name), getattr(torch_page, name))
+        # The last coordinate row is scratch for masked-out writes.
+        live = slice(0, fused_coord.max_reqs)
+        for name in ("st_marker", "st_pp", "cnt"):
+            fused, ref = getattr(fused_coord, name), getattr(torch_coord, name)
+            assert torch.equal(fused[live], ref[live])
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("local_blocks", [1, 3])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("max_block", [5, 16, 300])
+def test_local_union(local_blocks, max_block):
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(max_block)
+    allow = (torch.rand(4, 16, generator=gen) < 0.2).to(torch.int8).cuda()
+    # seq 1 sits in block 0; 300 * BS overruns a narrow table and is clamped.
+    seq = torch.tensor([1, BS, 2 * BS + 1, 300 * BS], dtype=torch.int32).cuda()
+    out = torch.full((4, max_block + 7), 3, dtype=torch.int8, device="cuda")
+    view = local_union_fused(
+        allow=allow,
+        seq_lens=seq,
+        out=out,
+        max_block=max_block,
+        block_size=BS,
+        local_blocks=local_blocks,
+    )
+    ref = local_union_reference(
+        allow=allow,
+        seq_lens=seq,
+        max_block=max_block,
+        block_size=BS,
+        local_blocks=local_blocks,
+    )
+    assert torch.equal(view.cpu(), ref)
+    assert bool((out[:, max_block:] == 3).all())
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "dim,page_pairs,mode,page_mod,dtype",
+    [
+        (64, 8, "resample", 0, torch.bfloat16),
+        (128, 24, "truncate", 0, torch.float32),
+        (96, 16, "resample", 5, torch.bfloat16),
+    ],
+)
+def test_cos_sin_2d(dim, page_pairs, mode, page_mod, dtype):
+    rope = PageRope2D(dim, 10000.0, 100.0, page_pairs, mode, page_mod)
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(dim)
+    tok = torch.randint(0, 5000, (37,), generator=gen).cuda()
+    page = torch.randint(0, 900, (37,), generator=gen).cuda()
+    out_cos = torch.empty(40, dim, dtype=dtype, device="cuda")
+    out_sin = torch.empty_like(out_cos)
+    cos, sin = cos_sin_2d_fused(
+        rope=rope,
+        tok_pos=tok,
+        page_pos=page,
+        dtype=dtype,
+        out_cos=out_cos,
+        out_sin=out_sin,
+    )
+    assert cos.data_ptr() == out_cos.data_ptr()
+    ref_cos, ref_sin = cos_sin_2d_reference(
+        inv_tok=rope.inv_tok.cuda(),
+        inv_page=rope.inv_page.cuda(),
+        tok_pos=tok,
+        page_pos=page,
+        page_mod=page_mod,
+        dtype=dtype,
+    )
+    tol = dict(atol=1e-5, rtol=0) if dtype == torch.float32 else dict(atol=8e-3, rtol=0)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(cos, ref_cos, **tol)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(sin, ref_sin, **tol)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "tokens,heads_x,heads_y,head_dim", [(1, 8, 1, 64), (33, 16, 2, 128)]
+)
+def test_page2d_rope_is_bit_identical_to_torch(tokens, heads_x, heads_y, head_dim):
+    """The fused bf16 RoPE rounds each product like PyTorch, so outputs are equal."""
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(tokens)
+
+    def rand(*shape):
+        return torch.randn(*shape, generator=gen).to(torch.bfloat16).cuda()
+
+    x, y = rand(tokens, heads_x * head_dim), rand(tokens, heads_y * head_dim)
+    cos, sin = rand(tokens, head_dim), rand(tokens, head_dim)
+    ref_x = page2d_rope_reference(x, cos, sin, head_dim)
+    assert torch.equal(apply_page2d_rope(x, cos, sin, head_dim), ref_x)
+    ox, oy = apply_page2d_rope_pair(x, y, cos, sin, head_dim)
+    assert torch.equal(ox, ref_x)
+    assert torch.equal(oy, page2d_rope_reference(y, cos, sin, head_dim))
+

+def _decode_backend(prompts, page_state, coord_state, bt, *, graph: bool):
+    """A backend holding only the decode-metadata state, on a prefilled batch."""
+    b = object.__new__(UnlimitedOCRV2AttnBackend)
+    b.device = torch.device("cuda")
+    b.block_size = BS
+    b.local_blocks = 1
+    b.buf_width = 4
+    b.num_layers = 0
+    b.image_bucket_constraint = True
+    b.max_context_len = WIDTH * BS
+    b.max_block_static = WIDTH
+    b.model_dtype = torch.float32
+    b.page_state, b.coord_state = page_state, coord_state
+    b.routers = [SimpleNamespace(image_only=True)]
+    b.rope_main = PageRope2D(64, 10000.0, 256.0, 8, "truncate", 0)
+    b.rope_index = PageRope2D(32, 10000.0, 256.0, 8, "resample", 0)
+    b.kv_pool = SimpleNamespace(
+        get_index_k_buffer=lambda _: torch.empty(NUM_BLOCKS * BS, 1, device="cuda")
+    )
+    pos = torch.arange(WIDTH * BS, device="cuda")
+    b.req_to_token = (bt.long()[:, pos // BS] * BS + pos % BS).to(torch.int32)
+    # Non-zero page bases so the RoPE page shift is part of the comparison.
+    b._page_base_row = torch.arange(len(prompts), device="cuda", dtype=torch.int64)
+    b._cos_sin_cache = {}
+    b._logged_first = True
+    b.forward_metadata = None
+    b.cg_max_bs = b.cg_max_tokens = 0
+    b._cg_ready = False
+    b._init_decode_buffer_slots()
+    b._init_prefill_buffer_slots()
+    if graph:
+        b.init_cuda_graph_state(max_bs=8, max_num_tokens=8)
+    return b
+
+
+def test_eager_decode_metadata_matches_graph_path():
+    """Decode without CUDA graphs must build the same step geometry as replay.
+
+    Bug: the eager decode step took the "refreshed inside the graph" branch,
+    which binds page ids, Page2D coordinates and the candidate mask to graph
+    buffers and defers filling them to the in-graph hook. Eager forwards never
+    run that hook, so decode tokens got no 2D RoPE and no page mask and the
+    model looped on block coordinates after the first decode token.
+    """
+    prompts = [_prompt(2, 60, True), _prompt(3, 40, True), _prompt(1, 121, True)]
+    page, coord, bt, seq = _prefilled_state(prompts, True)
+    eager = _decode_backend(prompts, page, coord, bt, graph=False)
+    graph = _decode_backend(
+        prompts, copy.deepcopy(page), copy.deepcopy(coord), bt, graph=True
+    )
+    mode = SimpleNamespace(
+        is_idle=lambda: False,
+        is_decode_or_idle=lambda: True,
+        is_target_verify=lambda: False,
+    )
+    rows = torch.arange(len(prompts), device="cuda")
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
+    choices = torch.tensor([PAGE, 4, 5, 6])
+    for _ in range(6):
+        seq = seq + 1
+        pos = seq.long() - 1
+        fb = SimpleNamespace(
+            forward_mode=mode,
+            input_ids=choices[
+                torch.randint(0, 4, (len(prompts),), generator=gen)
+            ].cuda(),
+            seq_lens=seq.long(),
+            seq_lens_cpu=seq.long().cpu(),
+            out_cache_loc=bt.long().gather(1, (pos // BS)[:, None]).squeeze(1) * BS
+            + pos % BS,
+            req_pool_indices=rows,
+        )
+        eager.init_forward_metadata(fb)
+        graph.init_forward_metadata_out_graph(fb)
+        graph.init_forward_metadata_in_graph(fb)
+        e, g = eager.forward_metadata, graph.forward_metadata
+        assert e.coords is not None and e.query_allow is not None
+        w = e.max_block
+        assert torch.equal(e.block_table, g.block_table[:, :w])
+        assert torch.equal(e.q_page, g.q_page)
+        assert torch.equal(e.coords[0], g.coords[0])
+        assert torch.equal(e.coords[1], g.coords[1])
+        assert torch.equal(e.query_allow.bool(), g.query_allow[:, :w].bool())
+        assert torch.equal(e.image_allow.bool(), g.image_allow[:, :w].bool())
+        for which in ("main", "index"):
+            ec, es = eager.cos_sin(which, torch.float32)
+            gc, gs = graph.cos_sin(which, torch.float32)

+"""DASH routing kernels (page summaries, block scores, 1.5-entmax top-k with
+centered log-prior bias; full-width, window-narrow and tiled decode scans) must
+match the PyTorch reference."""
+
+import sys
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import triton
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.unlimited_ocr_dash.route import (
+    SCAN_TILE,
+    _plan_decode_route,
+    _want_tiled,
+    kbar_all_plan,
+    kbar_refresh_tail_triton,
+    prefill_row2req,
+    route_decode_triton,
+    route_prefill_triton,
+    win_bounds_decode,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.kernels.unlimited_ocr_dash import (
+    block_scores_reference,
+    entmax_route_reference,
+    kbar_summary_reference,
+    win_bounds_reference,
+)
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=30, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="1-gpu-large")
+
+BS, D, NUM_PAGES = 128, 128, 8192
+ROUTER = dict(idx_scale=0.37, prior_floor=1e-2, sigma=1.3)
+
+
+def _block_table(rows, width, gen):
+    # Distinct pages per request: a repeated page would tie its block scores.
+    bt = torch.stack(
+        [torch.randperm(NUM_PAGES, generator=gen)[:width] for _ in range(rows)]
+    )
+    return bt.to(torch.int32).cuda()
+
+
+def _decode_inputs(width, seq_lens, dql, density, gen):
+    rows = len(seq_lens) * dql
+    idx_q = torch.randn(rows, D, generator=gen).to(torch.bfloat16).cuda()
+    k_bar = torch.randn(NUM_PAGES, D, generator=gen).cuda()
+    bt = _block_table(len(seq_lens), width, gen)
+    allow = torch.rand(rows, width, generator=gen) < density
+    return idx_q, k_bar, bt, allow.cuda()
+
+
+def _decode_reference(idx_q, k_bar, bt, seq, allow, width, dql, budget, out_slots):
+    seq_t = torch.tensor(seq, device="cuda")
+    row_req = torch.arange(len(seq), device="cuda").repeat_interleave(dql)
+    pos = seq_t[row_req] - dql + torch.arange(len(row_req), device="cuda") % dql
+    scores = block_scores_reference(
+        idx_q=idx_q,
+        k_bar=k_bar,
+        block_table=bt,
+        seq_lens=seq_t,
+        row_req=row_req,
+        query_pos=pos,
+        width=width,
+        block_size=BS,
+        local_blocks=1,
+    )
+    return entmax_route_reference(
+        scores=scores,
+        image_allow=allow,
+        budget=budget,
+        out_slots=out_slots,
+        **ROUTER,
+    )
+
+
+def _assert_routes(out_idx, out_bias, ref_idx, ref_bias):
+    M = ref_idx.shape[1]
+    assert torch.equal(out_idx[:, :M].cpu(), ref_idx)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out_bias[:, :M].cpu(), ref_bias, atol=2e-4, rtol=1e-4)
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(

+def _inputs(batch=2, queries=64, key_size=40, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda"):
+    rel_h = torch.randn(batch, 12, queries, key_size, 1, dtype=dtype, device=device)

+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "batch,queries,key_size",
+    [(8, 534, 40), (8, 1600, 40), (2, 1024, 64)],

+    torch.manual_seed(20260923)
+    rel_h, rel_w = _inputs(batch, queries, key_size)
+    expected = sam_rel_pos_bias_reference(rel_h, rel_w)
+    actual = sam_rel_pos_bias(rel_h, rel_w)
+    assert torch.equal(actual, expected)
+
+
+def test_query_chunks_stay_on_the_kernel():
+    """The SAM attention slices the query axis into chunks; slices must stay eligible."""
+    rel_h, rel_w = _inputs(queries=1600)
+    for s, e in ((0, 256), (256, 1333), (1333, 1600)):
+        h, w = rel_h[:, :, s:e], rel_w[:, :, s:e]

+        assert torch.equal(sam_rel_pos_bias(h, w), sam_rel_pos_bias_reference(h, w))
+
+
+def _strided_rel_w():
+    rel_h, _ = _inputs()
+    storage = torch.randn(2, 12, 64, 1, 80, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+    return rel_h, storage[..., ::2]
+
+
+def _misaligned_rel_w():
+    rel_h, _ = _inputs()
+    storage = torch.randn(2, 12, 64, 1, 48, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(

+"""window_unpartition_add must stay bit-identical to unpartition + residual add,
+for both BHWC and BCHW-permuted shortcut layouts."""
+
+import sys
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.elementwise.window_unpartition_add import (
+    can_use_window_unpartition_add,
+    window_unpartition_add,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.kernels.sam import make_windows, window_unpartition_add_reference
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=30, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="1-gpu-large")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("batch,height,width", [(1, 40, 40), (8, 40, 40), (2, 64, 64)])
+def test_window_unpartition_add_bit_identity(batch: int, height: int, width: int):
+    torch.manual_seed(20260923)
+    attention = torch.randn(
+        batch, height, width, 768, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16
+    )
+    shortcut = torch.randn_like(attention)
+    layouts = [shortcut]
+    layouts.append(
+        torch.randn(
+            batch, 768, height, width, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16
+        ).permute(0, 2, 3, 1)
+    )
+    windows = make_windows(attention, 14)
+    for shortcut_layout in layouts:
+        assert can_use_window_unpartition_add(windows, shortcut_layout, 14)
+        expected = window_unpartition_add_reference(windows, shortcut_layout, 14)
+        actual = window_unpartition_add(windows, shortcut_layout, 14)
+        assert actual.stride() == shortcut_layout.stride()
+        assert torch.equal(actual, expected)
+
+
+def _inputs(dtype=torch.bfloat16, hidden=768, device="cuda"):
+    shortcut = torch.randn(1, 40, 40, hidden, device=device, dtype=dtype)
+    return make_windows(torch.randn_like(shortcut), 14), shortcut
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "case",
+    [
+        "fp16",
+        "fp32",
+        "cpu",
+        "hidden_not_multiple_of_8",
+        "unsupported_shortcut_layout",
+        "non_contiguous_windows",
+        "window_count_mismatch",
+    ],
+)
+def test_unsupported_inputs_take_the_eager_path(case: str):
+    """Inputs the kernel rejects must take the eager unpartition + add."""
+    if case == "fp16":
+        windows, shortcut = _inputs(dtype=torch.float16)
+    elif case == "fp32":
+        windows, shortcut = _inputs(dtype=torch.float32)
+    elif case == "cpu":
+        windows, shortcut = _inputs(device="cpu")
+    elif case == "hidden_not_multiple_of_8":
+        windows, shortcut = _inputs(hidden=12)
+    elif case == "unsupported_shortcut_layout":
+        windows, _ = _inputs()
+        # [B, H, C, W] storage: neither BHWC nor BCHW-permuted.
+        shortcut = torch.randn(
+            1, 40, 768, 40, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16
+        ).permute(0, 1, 3, 2)
+    elif case == "non_contiguous_windows":
+        windows, shortcut = _inputs()
+        windows = windows.transpose(1, 2)
+    else:
+        windows, shortcut = _inputs()
+        windows = windows[1:]
+    assert not can_use_window_unpartition_add(windows, shortcut, 14)
+
+
+def test_kernel_rejects_non_bf16_inputs():
+    windows, shortcut = _inputs(dtype=torch.float16)
+    with pytest.raises(Exception, match="dtype|Tensor match failed"):
+        window_unpartition_add(windows, shortcut, 14)
+
+

+    sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v", "-s"]))

+class UnlimitedOcrCropTransferCudaTest(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_repeated_pinned_reuse_preserves_bytes(self):
+        # Prefetch off: every batch goes through the pinned staging slots.
+        with envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_UOCR_CROP_PREFETCH.override(False):
+            transfer = UnlimitedOcrCropTransfer(model_dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        self.addCleanup(transfer.close)
+        sources = [
+            [
+                torch.full((256, 256), float(step * 7 + page) / 123)
+                for page in range(1 + step % 7)
+            ]
+            for step in range(8)
+        ]
+        stream = torch.cuda.Stream(device=0)
+        outputs = []
+        with torch.cuda.stream(stream), torch.inference_mode():
+            torch.cuda._sleep(30_000_000)
+            for tensors in sources:
+                outputs.append(
+                    transfer.stack(
+                        tensors=tensors,
+                        dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+                        device=torch.device("cuda:0"),
+                    )
+                )
+        stream.synchronize()
+        for source, output in zip(sources, outputs):
+            expected = torch.stack(source).bfloat16()
+            self.assertTrue(
+                torch.equal(output.cpu().view(torch.uint8), expected.view(torch.uint8))
+            )

+class _ScriptedWindows:
+    """Answers each window of a split document with the next scripted text,
+    as the unary chat handler and the tokenizer manager's stream would."""
+
+    def __init__(self, answers):
+        self._answers = list(answers)
+        self._served = 0
+
+    def _next_answer(self) -> str:
+        answer = self._answers[self._served]
+        self._served += 1
+        return answer
+
+    async def handle_window(self, sub, raw_request):
+        answer = self._next_answer()
+        return ChatCompletionResponse(
+            id=sub.rid,
+            model="m",
+            choices=[
+                ChatCompletionResponseChoice(
+                    index=0,
+                    message=ChatMessage(role="assistant", content=answer),
+                    finish_reason="stop",
+                    meta_info={},
+                )
+            ],
+            usage=UsageInfo(prompt_tokens=10, completion_tokens=3, total_tokens=13),
+        )
+
+    async def generate_request(self, adapted, raw_request):
+        answer = self._next_answer()
+        # Cumulative text, as the stream reports it without incremental output.
+        cuts = sorted({len(answer) // 3, 2 * len(answer) // 3, len(answer)})
+        for cut in cuts:
+            done = cut == len(answer)
+            yield {
+                "text": answer[:cut],
+                "meta_info": {
+                    "prompt_tokens": 10,
+                    "completion_tokens": 3,
+                    "finish_reason": {"type": "stop", "matched": 1} if done else None,
+                },
+            }
+
+
+def _splitter(windows: _ScriptedWindows, *, config=None):
+    tokenizer_manager = SimpleNamespace(
+        model_config=SimpleNamespace(hf_config=_HF_CONFIG),
+        max_req_input_len=10**6,
+        rid_to_state={},
+        generate_request=windows.generate_request,
+        release_uocr_doc=lambda doc_id: None,
+    )
+    serving = SimpleNamespace(
+        tokenizer_manager=tokenizer_manager,
+        template_manager=SimpleNamespace(chat_template_name="unlimited-ocr"),
+        _effective_tools=lambda request: None,
+        _should_return_input_ids=lambda request: False,
+        _should_return_output_ids=lambda request: False,
+        reasoning_parser=None,
+        _validate_request=lambda request, **kwargs: None,
+        create_error_response=lambda message: message,
+        create_streaming_error_response=lambda message: message,
+        _request_id_prefix=lambda: "chatcmpl-",
+        _reported_prompt_tokens=lambda meta: meta["prompt_tokens"],
+        _convert_to_internal_request=lambda sub, raw: (
+            SimpleNamespace(rid=sub.rid),
+            None,
+        ),
+    )
+    return serving_chat_doc_split.ChatDocSplitter(
+        serving,
+        handle_window=windows.handle_window,
+        config=UocrDocumentConfig() if config is None else config,
+    )
+
+
+def _document_request(n_pages: int, *, stream: bool) -> ChatCompletionRequest:
+    content = [
+        {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": f"img{i}"}} for i in range(n_pages)
+    ]
+    content.append(
+        {"type": "text", "text": "<PAGE><image>" * n_pages + "Multi page parsing."}
+    )
+    return ChatCompletionRequest(
+        model="m",
+        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": content}],
+        max_tokens=10**5,
+        stream=stream,
+    )
+
+
+async def _serve_unary(plan, answers, n_pages):
+    response = await _splitter(_ScriptedWindows(answers))._handle_split_document(
+        _document_request(n_pages, stream=False), None, plan, doc_reuse_id=None
+    )
+    return (
+        response.choices[0].message.content,
+        response.choices[0].finish_reason,
+        response.metadata,
+    )
+
+
+async def _serve_stream(plan, answers, n_pages):
+    text, finish = "", None
+    async for chunk in _splitter(_ScriptedWindows(answers))._split_document_stream(
+        _document_request(n_pages, stream=True), None, plan, doc_reuse_id=None
+    ):
+        payload = chunk[len("data: ") :].strip()
+        if payload == "[DONE]":
+            break
+        choice = json.loads(payload)["choices"][0]
+        text += choice["delta"].get("content") or ""
+        finish = choice.get("finish_reason") or finish
+    return text, finish
+
+
+def _answers(lo, hi, *, malformed):
+    marker = doc_split.PAGE_MARKER
+    clean = [f"p{i}" for i in range(lo, hi)]
+    cases = [marker.join(clean)]
+    if malformed:
+        cases += [
+            marker.join([clean[0] + "dup", *clean]),  # repeated first page
+            marker.join([*clean, "extra"]),  # over-generation
+            "stray" + marker + marker.join(clean),  # text before the first marker
+            marker + marker.join(clean),  # one marker too many
+            marker.join([clean[0], "", *clean[1:]]),  # a page with no body
+        ]
+    return cases
+
+
+def _plans():
+    for n_pages, cap in ((3, 2), (4, 2), (5, 3), (10, 4)):
+        plan = _plan_batches(
+            n_pages=n_pages,
+            image_mode="base",
+            context_length=10**6,
+            max_batch_pages=cap,
+        )
+        yield n_pages, plan

+    def test_a_window_without_instruction_ends_on_the_extra_marker(self):
+        """Dropping the instruction made a reuse window's last page loop to the
+        token cap: <PAGE> was masked there and the model never chose EOS."""
+        P = self.PAGE
+        spliced = [30, 31, P]  # previous window's text tail + the forced marker
+        # Prompt = <PAGE> image tail + one owned page; the forced marker opens it.
+        _, req = self._row(2, [], cap=0, context_pages=1)
+        req.uocr_doc.end_on_marker = True

+        self.assertEqual(self._banned(row), set())
+        # That marker is past the window's pages, so the next step stops.
+        row, _ = self._row(2, spliced + [40, 41, P, 42], cap=0, req=req)
+        finite = torch.isfinite(row).nonzero().flatten().tolist()
+        self.assertEqual(finite, [self.EOS])
+
+    def test_stop_only_guard_ends_a_reuse_window_and_nothing_else(self):
+        """--uocr-max-page-tokens 0 turned the guard off, so a reuse
+        window without an instruction never stopped."""

+        spliced = [30, 31, P]

+        req.uocr_doc.end_on_marker = True

+        row, _ = self._row(2, spliced + [40] * 50, cap=0, req=req, stop_only=True)
+        self.assertEqual(self._banned(row), set())

+        finite = torch.isfinite(row).nonzero().flatten().tolist()

+        _, plain = self._row(2, [], cap=0, stop_only=True)
+        plain.uocr_doc.end_on_marker = False
+        row, _ = self._row(2, [P, 40, P, 41, P, 42], cap=0, req=plain, stop_only=True)
+        self.assertEqual(self._banned(row), set())
+
+    def test_a_lookahead_page_ends_the_window_on_its_marker(self):
+        """Window pages 2 + 1 lookahead: the lookahead page must not be
+        transcribed, and the last own page may still turn (it is the boundary
+        the cross-page markers live on)."""
+        P = self.PAGE
+        prompt = [P, self.IMG, self.IMG] * 3
+        req = _make_req(origin_input_ids=prompt, output_ids=[])
+
+        def row(out):
+            req.output_ids = out
+            params = [

+class TestNGramProcessorBatchEdits(CustomTestCase):
+    """A batch mixing forced, page-banned and n-gram-banned rows.
+
+    Regression: the edits were written row by row through Python indices; on
+    CUDA every write blocked the host on the forward that produced the logits.
+    """
+
+    PAGE, EOS, VOCAB = 7, 1, 64
+
+    def _batch(self):
+        """Two forced rows, two rows with a page and an n-gram ban, one skipped."""
+        P = self.PAGE
+
+        def req(output_ids):
+            r = _make_req(origin_input_ids=[P, 50, P, 50], output_ids=output_ids)
+            r.uocr_doc = UocrReqState(context_pages=0)
+            return r
+
+        common = {
+            "page_token_id": P,
+            "eos_token_id": self.EOS,
+            "ngram_size": 2,
+            "window_size": 100,
+            NGRAM_OUTPUT_ONLY_KEY: True,
+        }
+        return [
+            # Page cap reached on the last page: forced to EOS.
+            {"__req__": req([P, 3, P, 4, 4, 4]), "max_page_tokens": 3, **common},
+            # Repeating tail: forced to EOS.
+            {
+                "__req__": req([P, 2, 5, 2, 5, 2, 5]),
+                "max_page_tokens": 0,
+                "rep_max_pattern_size": 2,
+                "rep_min_count": 3,
+                **common,
+            },
+            # A page short: EOS banned, plus the n-gram ban of 3 after 2.
+            {"__req__": req([P, 2, 3, 2]), "max_page_tokens": 0, **common},
+            None,
+            # Last page: <PAGE> banned, plus the n-gram ban of 9 after 8.
+            {"__req__": req([P, 8, 9, P, 8]), "max_page_tokens": 0, **common},
+        ]
+
+    def _expected(self):
+        """What the per-row edits leave on all-zero logits."""
+        out = torch.zeros(5, self.VOCAB)
+        for row in (0, 1):
+            out[row] = -float("inf")
+            out[row, self.EOS] = 0.0
+        out[2, [self.EOS, 3]] = -float("inf")
+        out[4, [self.PAGE, 9]] = -float("inf")
+        return out
+
+    def test_every_row_gets_its_own_edits(self):
+        result = DeepseekOCRNoRepeatNGramLogitProcessor()(
+            torch.zeros(5, self.VOCAB), self._batch()
+        )
+        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(result, self._expected()))
+
+    @unittest.skipUnless(torch.cuda.is_available(), "needs CUDA")
+    def test_cuda_edits_match_and_do_not_sync(self):
+        logits = torch.zeros(5, self.VOCAB, device="cuda")
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        previous = torch.cuda.get_sync_debug_mode()
+        torch.cuda.set_sync_debug_mode("error")
+        try:
+            result = DeepseekOCRNoRepeatNGramLogitProcessor()(logits, self._batch())
+        finally:
+            torch.cuda.set_sync_debug_mode(previous)
+        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(result.cpu(), self._expected()))
+

+"""CPU tests for the split-document next-window prefetch (park, release, budget)."""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.models.unlimited_ocr_v2_support import document_prefetch as p
+from sglang.srt.models.unlimited_ocr_v2_support.document_reuse import UocrReqState
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=2, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+def _req(rid, *, after=None, budget=None, keep=False, max_new=1000):
+    """A minimal request stand-in for one document window."""
+    cp = {"uocr_doc_keep": keep}
+    if after is not None:
+        cp[p.KEY_AFTER] = after
+        cp[p.KEY_BUDGET] = budget
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        rid=rid,
+        sampling_params=SimpleNamespace(custom_params=cp, max_new_tokens=max_new),
+        multimodal_inputs=None,
+        output_ids=[],
+        finished_len=None,
+        finished=lambda: False,
+        uocr_doc=None,
+    )
+
+
+def _prefetch():
+    return p.DocPrefetch(
+        early=None, device=torch.device("cpu"), forward_stream=None, tp_size=1
+    )
+
+
+class _Sched:
+    """Scheduler stand-in: a waiting queue that parks follow-ups first."""
+
+    def __init__(self, prefetch):
+        self.prefetch = prefetch
+        self.queue = []
+
+    def add(self, req):
+        if not self.prefetch.park(req):
+            self.queue.append(req)
+
+    def ingest(self):
+        """The scheduler queues released windows at the top of its next step."""
+        for req in self.prefetch.take_released():
+            self.add(req)
+
+
+def _finish(req, n_out, forced=0):
+    """Mark a window finished with ``n_out`` outputs, ``forced`` of them spliced."""
+    req.output_ids = list(range(n_out))
+    req.uocr_doc = UocrReqState(forced_len=forced)
+    req.finished = lambda: True
+
+
+class TestNextWindowPrefetch(CustomTestCase):
+    """A prefetched window waits for its predecessor and inherits its budget."""
+
+    def test_a_follow_up_waits_for_its_window_and_takes_the_rest_of_the_budget(self):
+        """Sent while window 0 decodes, window 1 must not start before window 0
+        has retained its KV, and its budget is what window 0 left over. The
+        release happens while window 0's KV is freed, so the window is only
+        recorded there and the scheduler queues it on its next step."""
+        prefetch = _prefetch()
+        sched = _Sched(prefetch)
+        w0 = _req("w0", keep=True)
+        w1 = _req("w1", after="w0", budget=1000)
+        sched.add(w1)
+        self.assertEqual(sched.queue, [])
+        _finish(w0, 300, forced=0)
+        prefetch.on_window_finished(w0)
+        self.assertEqual(sched.queue, [])
+        sched.ingest()
+        self.assertEqual(sched.queue, [w1])
+        self.assertEqual(w1.sampling_params.max_new_tokens, 700)
+        self.assertEqual(prefetch.take_released(), [])
+
+    def test_a_follow_up_arriving_late_is_not_parked(self):
+        """If the window already finished, the follow-up must go straight in,
+        or it would wait forever for a release that already happened."""
+        prefetch = _prefetch()
+        sched = _Sched(prefetch)
+        w0 = _req("w0", keep=True)
+        _finish(w0, 150, forced=129)
+        prefetch.on_window_finished(w0)
+        w1 = _req("w1", after="w0", budget=500)
+        sched.add(w1)
+        self.assertEqual(sched.queue, [w1])
+        # Spliced text is not generation; it does not spend the budget.
+        self.assertEqual(w1.sampling_params.max_new_tokens, 479)
+
+    def test_a_retracted_window_releases_nothing(self):
+        """Retraction passes the same cache hook unfinished; releasing there
+        would start the follow-up before the window's KV is retained."""
+        prefetch = _prefetch()
+        sched = _Sched(prefetch)
+        w0 = _req("w0", keep=True)
+        w1 = _req("w1", after="w0", budget=1000)
+        sched.add(w1)
+        prefetch.on_window_finished(w0)
+        sched.ingest()
+        self.assertEqual(sched.queue, [])
+
+    def test_aborting_the_document_drops_its_held_windows(self):
+        """An abort must reach a window still parked off the queue, and one
+        released but not yet queued by the scheduler."""
+        prefetch = _prefetch()
+        sched = _Sched(prefetch)
+        w1 = _req("doc-w1-ab", after="doc-w0-cd", budget=1000)
+        sched.add(w1)
+        self.assertEqual(prefetch.drop("doc-w1"), [w1])
+        self.assertEqual(prefetch.held_count(), 0)
+
+        w0 = _req("doc-w0-ef", keep=True)
+        w2 = _req("doc-w2-gh", after="doc-w0-ef", budget=1000)
+        sched.add(w2)
+        _finish(w0, 10)
+        prefetch.on_window_finished(w0)
+        self.assertEqual(prefetch.drop("doc-w2"), [w2])
+        sched.ingest()
+        self.assertEqual(sched.queue, [])
+
+    def test_reset_hands_back_every_held_window(self):
+        """A cache flush aborts held windows; any it forgot would never be
+        answered."""
+        prefetch = _prefetch()
+        sched = _Sched(prefetch)
+        w0 = _req("w0", keep=True)
+        parked = _req("w2", after="w1", budget=10)
+        released = _req("w1b", after="w0", budget=10)
+        sched.add(parked)
+        sched.add(released)
+        _finish(w0, 1)
+        prefetch.on_window_finished(w0)
+        self.assertCountEqual(prefetch.reset(), [parked, released])
+        self.assertEqual(prefetch.held_count(), 0)
+        self.assertEqual(prefetch.take_released(), [])
+
+
+class TestEarlyEmbeddings(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_early_embedding_must_match_the_item_length(self):
+        """A stale embedding of another length must not replace the vision pass."""
+        early = p.EarlyEmbeddings(encode=lambda items: None)
+        early._by_hash[42] = torch.zeros(5, 4)
+        self.assertTrue(early.has_prefetched())
+        self.assertIsNotNone(early.prefetched(42, 5))
+        self.assertIsNone(early.prefetched(42, 6))
+        self.assertIsNone(early.prefetched(None, 5))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+    def test_step_memory_does_not_scale_with_tokens_times_pages(self):
+        """A dense [tokens, pages] count table made one prefill chunk allocate
+        tens of GiB once the page capacity was raised (100000 pages OOMed)."""
+        ids = prompt([(0, 2), (1, 3)]) + [PAGE, 40, 41, PAGE, 42]
+        gen = len(prompt([(0, 2), (1, 3)]))
+        small = PageCoordState(CFG, max_reqs=2, max_pages=16)
+        big = PageCoordState(CFG, max_reqs=2, max_pages=1 << 20)
+        lay = layout(0, len(ids), False, gen_start=gen)
+        want = small.step(torch.tensor(ids), lay)
+        real_zeros = torch.zeros
+        sizes = []
+
+        def tracking_zeros(*shape, **kw):
+            dims = (
+                shape[0] if len(shape) == 1 and isinstance(shape[0], tuple) else shape
+            )
+            sizes.append(int(torch.Size(dims).numel()))
+            return real_zeros(*shape, **kw)
+
+        big._ensure(torch.device("cpu"))
+        torch.zeros = tracking_zeros
+        try:
+            got = big.step(torch.tensor(ids), lay)
+        finally:
+            torch.zeros = real_zeros
+        self.assertEqual(got[0].tolist(), want[0].tolist())
+        self.assertEqual(got[1].tolist(), want[1].tolist())
+        # One per-request carry row is fine; one per token is the bug.
+        self.assertLessEqual(max(sizes), 1 << 20)

+    def test_a_seeded_row_whose_request_never_steps_is_unpinned(self):

+class TestReuseContinuationCoords(CustomTestCase):
+    """A reuse window must decode on whole-document coordinates.
+
+    The spliced text keeps the KV the source window baked, so the carry seeded
+    for the first decode step has to land the next page where a single-pass run
+    puts it -- on both axes, since token positions count inside a page bucket.
+    """
+
+    PAGES = [(p, 200) for p in range(4)]
+    TEXT = [(60 + p, 61 + p) for p in range(4)]
+
+    def _out(self, first, last):
+        """Response for document pages ``[first, last)``: a marker, then text."""
+        out = []
+        for p in range(first, last):
+            out += [PAGE] + list(self.TEXT[p])
+        return out
+
+    def _stream(self, ids, gen, base=0, seed=None):
+        """Prefill ``ids[:gen]``, then decode the rest one token at a time."""
+        state = PageCoordState(CFG, max_reqs=2, max_pages=64)
+        tok, page = state.step(torch.tensor(ids[:gen]), layout(0, gen, False))
+        got = list(zip(tok.tolist(), page.tolist()))
+        if seed is not None:
+            marker, pp, cnt = seed
+            state.st_marker[0] = marker
+            state.st_pp[0] = pp
+            state.cnt[0] = torch.tensor(cnt, dtype=state.cnt.dtype)
+        for pos in range(gen, len(ids)):
+            tok, page = state.step(torch.tensor([ids[pos]]), layout(pos, 1, True))
+            got += list(zip(tok.tolist(), page.tolist()))
+        # The backend adds the window's page base to every real page.
+        return [(t, p + base if p > 0 else p) for t, p in got]
+
+    def _reference(self):
+        ids = prompt(self.PAGES)
+        return self._stream(ids + self._out(0, 4), len(ids))[len(ids) :]
+
+    def test_window_decodes_on_whole_document_coordinates(self):
+        old = prompt(self.PAGES[:3])
+        new = prompt(self.PAGES[2:])
+        plan = r.plan_tail_copy(old, new, 1, PAGE, IMG, 32)
+        self.assertIsNotNone(plan)
+        # Window [2, 4) with one overlap page emits from document page 3.
+        emit_from, base = 3, 3 - r.CONTEXT_PAGES
+        coord, (iso_marker, _, iso_pp) = r.continuation_carry(
+            plan.new_ids, PAGE, IMG, CFG["per_page_image_tokens"], 64
+        )
+        decode = self._out(emit_from, 4)
+        got = self._stream(plan.new_ids + decode, len(plan.new_ids), base, coord)
+        want = self._reference()[-len(decode) :]
+        self.assertEqual(got[-len(decode) :], want)
+        # Page isolation derives the same page from its own carry.
+        self.assertEqual(iso_marker + 1 - 1 - iso_pp, want[0][1] - base - 1)
+
+    def test_source_window_text_matches_the_document(self):
+        """The spliced KV is only valid if the source baked these coordinates."""
+        old = prompt(self.PAGES[:3])
+        got = self._stream(old + self._out(0, 3), len(old))[len(old) :]
+        self.assertEqual(got, self._reference()[: len(got)])
+
+    def test_decoding_without_the_carry_takes_the_context_pages(self):
+        old = prompt(self.PAGES[:3])
+        new = prompt(self.PAGES[2:])
+        plan = r.plan_tail_copy(old, new, 1, PAGE, IMG, 32)
+        decode = self._out(3, 4)
+        got = self._stream(
+            plan.new_ids + decode, len(plan.new_ids), 3 - r.CONTEXT_PAGES
+        )
+        # Without the seed the window transcribes the image tail first, so its
+        # pages trail the document by CONTEXT_PAGES.
+        self.assertEqual(
+            got[-len(decode)][1] + r.CONTEXT_PAGES, self._reference()[-len(decode)][1]
+        )
+

+class _AllocatingAllocator(_FakeAllocator):
+    """Hands out consecutive slots so tests can tell copies from frees."""
+
+    def __init__(self, start=1000):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.next = start
+        self.allocated = []
+
+    def alloc(self, n):
+        out = torch.arange(self.next, self.next + n, dtype=torch.int64)
+        self.next += n
+        self.allocated.append(out.tolist())
+        return out

@@ -59,6 +71,48 @@ def test_encode_decode_roundtrip(self):
         self.assertGreater(len(ids), 0)
         self.assertEqual(tokenizer.decode(ids, skip_special_tokens=True), text)
 
+    def test_v5_rebuilt_pre_tokenizer_loads_and_matches_tokenizer_json(self):
+        """A ByteLevel tokenizer.json declared as LlamaTokenizerFast must load.
+
+        The v5 class rebuilds a Metaspace pre-tokenizer, which fastokens rejects
+        when it shims the backend before sglang restores tokenizer.json's own.
+        """
+        from tokenizers import Tokenizer, decoders, models, pre_tokenizers, trainers
+
+        from sglang.srt.utils.hf_transformers.tokenizer import get_tokenizer
+
+        raw = Tokenizer(models.BPE())
+        raw.pre_tokenizer = pre_tokenizers.ByteLevel(add_prefix_space=False)
+        raw.decoder = decoders.ByteLevel()
+        trainer = trainers.BpeTrainer(
+            vocab_size=400,
+            special_tokens=["<s>", "</s>", "<PAGE>"],
+            initial_alphabet=pre_tokenizers.ByteLevel.alphabet(),
+        )
+        raw.train_from_iterator(["Multi page parsing.", "中文 OCR"] * 20, trainer)
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as path:
+            raw.save(os.path.join(path, "tokenizer.json"))
+            with open(os.path.join(path, "tokenizer_config.json"), "w") as f:
+                json.dump(
+                    {
+                        "tokenizer_class": "LlamaTokenizerFast",
+                        "bos_token": "<s>",
+                        "eos_token": "</s>",
+                    },
+                    f,
+                )
+            tokenizer = get_tokenizer(path, tokenizer_backend="fastokens")
+
+        from fastokens._compat import _TokenizerShim
+
+        self.assertIsInstance(tokenizer._tokenizer, _TokenizerShim)
+        text = "<PAGE>中文 OCR page parsing"
+        ids = tokenizer.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False)
+        self.assertEqual(ids, raw.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False).ids)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            tokenizer.decode(ids), raw.decode(ids, skip_special_tokens=False)
+        )

+import base64
+import io
+import unittest
+
+import openai
+from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.vlm_utils import TestOpenAIMLLMServerBase
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=120, stage="base-b", runner_config="1-gpu-large")
+
+PAGE = "<PAGE>"
+# One distinct number per page of the multi-page document, in page order.
+PAGE_NUMBERS = ("31415", "27182", "16180")
+
+
+def _font(size: int):
+    for path in (
+        "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf",
+        "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation2/LiberationSans-Regular.ttf",
+    ):
+        try:
+            return ImageFont.truetype(path, size=size)
+        except OSError:
+            pass
+    return ImageFont.load_default()
+
+
+def _image_part(img: Image.Image) -> dict:
+    buffer = io.BytesIO()
+    img.save(buffer, format="PNG")
+    encoded = base64.b64encode(buffer.getvalue()).decode("ascii")
+    return {
+        "type": "image_url",
+        "image_url": {"url": f"data:image/png;base64,{encoded}"},
+    }
+
+
+def _ocr_image() -> Image.Image:
+    img = Image.new("RGB", (640, 360), "white")
+    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
+    draw.rectangle((24, 24, 616, 336), outline="black", width=4)
+    draw.text((72, 92), "SGLang OCR", fill="black", font=_font(56))
+    draw.text((72, 180), "12345", fill="black", font=_font(72))
+    return img
+
+
+def _document_page(number: str) -> Image.Image:
+    img = Image.new("RGB", (768, 1024), "white")
+    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
+    draw.text((80, 120), "Quarterly Report", fill="black", font=_font(56))
+    draw.text((80, 320), f"Account {number}", fill="black", font=_font(72))
+    return img
+
+
+def _document_content(pages) -> list:
+    """The model card's prompt: images first, then one marker run per page."""
+    text = PAGE + "<image>"
+    prompt = text * len(pages) + "Multi page parsing."
+    return [_image_part(page) for page in pages] + [{"type": "text", "text": prompt}]
+
+
+class TestUnlimitedOCRV2Server(TestOpenAIMLLMServerBase):
+    model = "baidu/Unlimited-OCR-2"
+    trust_remote_code = False
+    extra_args = [
+        "--revision=5632329a32e103d5f1add270681e0f5c1233c6e4",
+        "--chat-template=unlimited-ocr",
+        "--enable-streaming-session",
+        # Small per-page cap and one page per base-mode window, so the
+        # three-page document splits into three windows that reuse KV.
+        "--uocr-max-page-tokens=512",
+        "--uocr-doc-split",
+        "--uocr-doc-page-window=1",
+        # Workaround: eager decode degenerates into repeated numbers on this
+        # checkpoint; drop once it matches the decode CUDA graph path.
+        "--cuda-graph-backend-decode=full",
+        "--cuda-graph-max-bs-decode=4",
+        "--mem-fraction-static=0.7",
+    ]
+
+    def _chat(self, content, *, max_tokens, crop_mode):
+        client = openai.Client(api_key=self.api_key, base_url=self.base_url)
+        return client.chat.completions.create(
+            model="default",
+            messages=[{"role": "user", "content": content}],
+            temperature=0,
+            max_tokens=max_tokens,
+            extra_body={
+                "images_config": {"crop_mode": crop_mode},
+                "skip_special_tokens": False,
+            },
+        )
+
+    def test_single_image_chat_completion(self):
+        response = self._chat(
+            _document_content([_ocr_image()]), max_tokens=256, crop_mode=True
+        )
+
+        self.assertEqual(response.choices[0].message.role, "assistant")
+        text = response.choices[0].message.content
+        self.assertIn("12345", text)
+        self.assertIn("sglang", text.lower())
+        self.assertGreater(response.usage.prompt_tokens, 0)
+        self.assertGreater(response.usage.completion_tokens, 0)
+
+    def test_external_processors_remain_disabled(self):
+        client = openai.Client(api_key=self.api_key, base_url=self.base_url)
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(
+            openai.BadRequestError, "--enable-custom-logit-processor"
+        ):
+            client.chat.completions.create(
+                model="default",
+                messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
+                max_tokens=1,
+                extra_body={"custom_logit_processor": "external-processor"},
+            )
+
+    def test_split_document_returns_every_page_in_order(self):
+        pages = [_document_page(number) for number in PAGE_NUMBERS]
+        response = self._chat(
+            _document_content(pages), max_tokens=512 * len(pages), crop_mode=False
+        )
+
+        metadata = response.model_dump()["metadata"]
+        self.assertEqual(metadata["doc_split_batches"], len(pages))
+        self.assertTrue(metadata["doc_split_complete"], metadata)
+        # Every window after the first spliced its predecessor's KV tail.
+        self.assertEqual(metadata["doc_split_reused_batches"], [1, 2])
+        bodies = response.choices[0].message.content.split(PAGE)[1:]
+        self.assertEqual(len(bodies), len(pages), bodies)
+        for number, body in zip(PAGE_NUMBERS, bodies):
+            with self.subTest(number=number):
+                self.assertIn(number, body)
+
+
+del TestOpenAIMLLMServerBase
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
